steps.message:
# RL training run diagnosis

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a historical snapshot: inspect its source,
effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic, logs,
tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an unusual
setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health. A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.

Do not launch a full training run, use the network, or modify the historical
snapshot. The dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation
interval are fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$PTDBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the verdict, identify the concrete root cause or causes, and explain the
causal chain using specific workspace evidence. Distinguish root causes from
symptoms. Do not propose or implement a fix, and do not write other deliverable
files.
I'll start by exploring the workspace to understand the structure of this staged experiment.

steps.message: Let me read the launch script, the asset manifest, and the log structure first.

results.content:
1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# GRPO | Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct | geometry3k | FSDP + vLLM
3	set -euo pipefail
4	export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
5	unset PYTHONHOME
6	WORKSPACE="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
7	# Optional shared venv for the selected existing image. In the task Docker
8	# image, leave this unset and use the image's already-installed environment.
9	if [[ -n "${QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR:-}" ]]; then
10	    [[ -x "$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR/bin/python" ]] || { printf 'Missing environment: %s\n' "$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
11	    export VIRTUAL_ENV="$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR"
12	    export PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
13	    RUNTIME_SITE="$(python3 -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])')"
14	    RUNTIME_LIBS="$(python3 - "$RUNTIME_SITE" <<'PY'
15	from pathlib import Path
16	import sys
17	site = Path(sys.argv[1])
18	print(':'.join([str(site / 'torch/lib')] + [str(p) for p in sorted((site / 'nvidia').rglob('lib')) if p.is_dir()]))
19	PY
20	)"
21	    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RUNTIME_LIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
22	    if [[ -x "$RUNTIME_SITE/nvidia/cu13/bin/nvcc" ]]; then
23	        export CUDA_HOME="$RUNTIME_SITE/nvidia/cu13"
24	        export PATH="$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
25	        export CPATH="$CUDA_HOME/include/cccl${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
26	    fi
27	fi
28	export PYTHONPATH="$WORKSPACE/verl${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
29	MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-$WORKSPACE/models/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct}"
30	TRAIN_FILE="${TRAIN_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/train.parquet}"
31	TEST_FILE="${TEST_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/test.parquet}"
32	LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-$WORKSPACE/logs}"
33	NGPUS_PER_NODE="${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-8}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GRPO | Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct | geometry3k | FSDP + vLLM
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
unset PYTHONHOME
WORKSPACE="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# Optional shared venv for the selected existing image. In the task Docker
# image, leave this unset and use the image's already-installed environment.
if [[ -n "${QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    [[ -x "$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR/bin/python" ]] || { printf 'Missing environment: %s\n' "$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
    export VIRTUAL_ENV="$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR"
    export PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
    RUNTIME_SITE="$(python3 -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])')"
    RUNTIME_LIBS="$(python3 - "$RUNTIME_SITE" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
site = Path(sys.argv[1])
print(':'.join([str(site / 'torch/lib')] + [str(p) for p in sorted((site / 'nvidia').rglob('lib')) if p.is_dir()]))
PY
)"
    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RUNTIME_LIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
    if [[ -x "$RUNTIME_SITE/nvidia/cu13/bin/nvcc" ]]; then
        export CUDA_HOME="$RUNTIME_SITE/nvidia/cu13"
        export PATH="$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
        export CPATH="$CUDA_HOME/include/cccl${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
    fi
fi
export PYTHONPATH="$WORKSPACE/verl${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-$WORKSPACE/models/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct}"
TRAIN_FILE="${TRAIN_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/train.parquet}"
TEST_FILE="${TEST_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/test.parquet}"
LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-$WORKSPACE/logs}"
NGPUS_PER_NODE="${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-8}"
TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS="${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS:-20}"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
export WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_API_KEY=offline
export WANDB_DIR="${WANDB_DIR:-$LOG_DIR}"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
for asset in "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" "$TRAIN_FILE" "$TEST_FILE"; do
    [[ -f "$asset" ]] || { printf 'Missing prepared asset: %s\n' "$asset" >&2; exit 2; }
done
cd "$WORKSPACE/verl"
python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo \
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False \
    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILE" \
    data.val_files="$TEST_FILE" \
    data.train_batch_size=32 \
    data.max_prompt_length=2048 \
    data.max_response_length=8192 \
    data.image_key=images \
    data.image_patch_size=16 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.truncation=error \
    data.dataloader_num_workers=2 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL_PATH" \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.strategy=fsdp2 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=16 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=16384 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.01 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.model_dtype=fp32 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.dtype=bfloat16 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=10240 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.4 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=5 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=16384 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=16384 \
    trainer.use_v1=True \
    trainer.v1.trainer_mode=sync \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node="$NGPUS_PER_NODE" \
    trainer.nnodes=1 \
    trainer.logger='[console,wandb]' \
    trainer.project_name=geometry3k_grpo \
    trainer.experiment_name=qwen3vl_8b_fsdp \
    trainer.resume_mode=disable \
    trainer.val_before_train=True \
    trainer.test_freq=5 \
    trainer.save_freq=20 \
    trainer.total_training_steps="$TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS" \
    trainer.total_epochs=15 \
    trainer.default_local_dir="$LOG_DIR/checkpoints" \
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts" \
    trainer.validation_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/validation" \
    "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"

import re

from mathruler.grader import extract_boxed_content, grade_answer


def format_reward(predict_str: str) -> float:
    pattern = re.compile(r"<think>.*</think>.*\\boxed\{.*\}.*", re.DOTALL)
    match_result = re.fullmatch(pattern, predict_str)
    return 1.0 if match_result else 0.0


def acc_reward(predict_str: str, ground_truth: str, use_boxed: bool = True) -> float:
    if use_boxed:
        answer = extract_boxed_content(predict_str)
    else:
        answer = predict_str
    return 1.0 if grade_answer(answer, ground_truth) else 0.0


def compute_score(predict_str: str, ground_truth: str, use_boxed: bool = True, format_score: float = 0.1) -> float:
    return (1.0 - format_score) * acc_reward(predict_str, ground_truth, use_boxed) + format_score * format_reward(
        predict_str
    )

            # For multi-output agent loops, only use the final output per session for metrics.
            # Keys have format {uid}_{session_id}_{index}; keep only the highest index per session.
            session_max: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # session_key -> (max_index, position)
            for pos, key in enumerate(batch.keys):
                parts = key.rsplit("_", 2)
                if len(parts) == 3:
                    session_key = f"{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}"
                    index = int(parts[2])
                    if session_key not in session_max or index > session_max[session_key][0]:
                        session_max[session_key] = (index, pos)
                else:
                    session_max[key] = (0, pos)
            sorted_sessions = sorted(session_max.items(), key=lambda x: x[1][1])
            final_indices = [pos for _, (_, pos) in sorted_sessions]
            final_keys = [batch.keys[i] for i in final_indices]
            base_offset = len(sample_scores)
            session_to_sample_idx.update(
                {session_key: base_offset + j for j, (session_key, _) in enumerate(sorted_sessions)}
            )

            text_data = tq.kv_batch_get(
                keys=batch.keys, partition_id=batch.partition_id, select_fields=["prompts", "responses"]
            )
            text_data["prompts"] = text_data["prompts"].to_padded_tensor(padding=self.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
            text_data["responses"] = text_data["responses"].to_padded_tensor(padding=self.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
            all_inputs = [self.tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True) for ids in text_data["prompts"]]
            all_outputs = [self.tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True) for ids in text_data["responses"]]

            fields = ["uid", "rm_scores", "num_turns", "reward_model", "data_source", "extra_fields"]
            data = tq.kv_batch_get(keys=final_keys, partition_id=batch.partition_id, select_fields=fields)

            sample_uids.extend(data.pop("uid").tolist())
            sample_outputs.extend(all_outputs[i] for i in final_indices)
            sample_inputs.extend(all_inputs[i] for i in final_indices)
            scores = data["rm_scores"].sum(dim=1).tolist()
            sample_scores.extend(scores)
            sample_turns.extend(data.pop("num_turns").tolist())
            reward_extra_infos_dict["reward"].extend(scores)

            extra_fields_list = data.pop("extra_fields", None)
            if extra_fields_list is not None:
                n_prior = len(reward_extra_infos_dict["reward"]) - len(extra_fields_list.tolist())
                for extra_field in extra_fields_list.tolist():
                    reward_extra_info = (
                        extra_field.get("reward_extra_info", {}) if isinstance(extra_field, dict) else {}
                    )
                    for key in reward_extra_infos_dict:
                        if key != "reward" and key not in reward_extra_info:
                            reward_extra_infos_dict[key].append(None)
                    for key, value in reward_extra_info.items():
                        if key not in reward_extra_infos_dict:
                            reward_extra_infos_dict[key] = [None] * n_prior
                        reward_extra_infos_dict[key].append(value)
                    n_prior += 1

            reward_model = data.pop("reward_model", None)
            if reward_model is not None:
                sample_gts.extend([item.get("ground_truth", None) for item in reward_model.tolist()])
            else:
                sample_gts.extend([None] * len(final_indices))

            data_source = data.pop("data_source", None)
            if data_source is not None:
                data_sources.extend(data_source.tolist())
            else:
                data_sources.extend(["unknown"] * len(final_indices))

            dump_all_inputs.extend(all_inputs)
            dump_all_outputs.extend(all_outputs)

    def _maybe_log_val_generations(self, inputs, outputs, scores):
        """Log a table of validation samples to the configured logger (wandb or swanlab)"""
        generations_to_log = self.config.trainer.log_val_generations
        if generations_to_log == 0:
            return

        samples = list(zip(inputs, outputs, scores, strict=True))
        samples.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])  # Sort by input text

        # Use fixed random seed for deterministic shuffling
        rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
        rng.shuffle(samples)

        # Take first N samples after shuffling
        samples = samples[:generations_to_log]

        # Log to each configured logger
        self.validation_generations_logger.log(self.config.trainer.logger, samples, self.global_steps)

    @staticmethod
    def _write_generations(inputs, outputs, gts, scores, reward_extra_infos_dict, dump_path, global_steps):
        """Write generation samples as JSONL (runs in background thread)."""
        os.makedirs(dump_path, exist_ok=True)
        filename = os.path.join(dump_path, f"{global_steps}.jsonl")

        n = len(inputs)
        base_data = {
            "input": inputs,
            "output": outputs,
            "gts": gts,
            "score": scores,
            "step": [global_steps] * n,
        }

        for k, v in reward_extra_infos_dict.items():
            if len(v) == n:
                base_data[k] = v

        def json_encode_default(obj):
            if isinstance(obj, np.integer):
                return int(obj)
            elif isinstance(obj, np.floating):
                return float(obj)
            elif isinstance(obj, np.bool_):
                return bool(obj)
            elif hasattr(obj, "tolist"):
                return obj.tolist()
            raise TypeError(f"Object of type {type(obj).__name__} is not JSON serializable")

        with open(filename, "w") as f:
            for i in range(n):
                entry = {k: v[i] for k, v in base_data.items()}
                f.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, default=json_encode_default) + "\n")

        print(f"Dumped generations to {filename}")

    def _dump_generations(self, inputs, outputs, gts, scores, reward_extra_infos_dict, dump_path):
        """Dump rollout/validation samples as JSONL asynchronously."""
        global_steps = self.global_steps
        future = self._dump_executor.submit(
            self._write_generations,
            inputs,
            outputs,
            gts,
            scores,
            reward_extra_infos_dict,
            dump_path,
            global_steps,
        )
        self._dump_futures.append(future)
        # Clean up completed futures and surface any exceptions early
        still_pending = []
        for f in self._dump_futures:
            if f.done():
                f.result()  # re-raises if the write failed
            else:
                still_pending.append(f)
        self._dump_futures = still_pending

    def _init_dump_executor(self):
        """Create or recreate the dump executor and futures list."""
        self._dump_executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
        self._dump_futures = []

    def _shutdown_dump_executor(self):
        """Drain pending dump futures and shut down the executor."""
        for f in self._dump_futures:
            f.result()
        self._dump_futures.clear()
        self._dump_executor.shutdown(wait=True)

Returns:
        A dictionary of metrics including:
            - critic/score/mean, max, min: Statistics about sequence scores
            - critic/rewards/mean, max, min: Statistics about sequence rewards
            - critic/advantages/mean, max, min: Statistics about advantages
            - critic/returns/mean, max, min: Statistics about returns
            - critic/values/mean, max, min: Statistics about critic values (if use_critic=True)
            - critic/vf_explained_var: Explained variance of the value function (if use_critic=True)
            - response_length/mean, max, min, clip_ratio: Statistics about response lengths
            - prompt_length/mean, max, min, clip_ratio: Statistics about prompt lengths
            - num_turns/mean, max, min: Statistics about the number of multi-turn conversations
    """
    sequence_score = batch.batch["token_level_scores"].sum(-1)
    sequence_reward = batch.batch["token_level_rewards"].sum(-1)

    advantages = batch.batch["advantages"]
    returns = batch.batch["returns"]

    max_prompt_length = batch.batch["prompts"].shape[-1]
    max_response_length = batch.batch["responses"].shape[-1]

    response_mask = batch.batch["response_mask"].bool()

    response_info = _compute_response_info(batch)
    prompt_length = response_info["prompt_length"]
    response_length = response_info["response_length"]

    aborted_mask = (response_length == 0).bool()
    non_aborted_mask = ~aborted_mask

    non_aborted_sequence_score = sequence_score[non_aborted_mask]
    non_aborted_sequence_reward = sequence_reward[non_aborted_mask]

    if non_aborted_sequence_score.numel() > 0:
        score_mean = torch.mean(non_aborted_sequence_score).detach().item()
        score_max = torch.max(non_aborted_sequence_score).detach().item()
        score_min = torch.min(non_aborted_sequence_score).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("All samples are aborted, returning default score metrics")
        score_mean = score_max = score_min = float("nan")

    if non_aborted_sequence_reward.numel() > 0:
        reward_mean = torch.mean(non_aborted_sequence_reward).detach().item()
        reward_max = torch.max(non_aborted_sequence_reward).detach().item()
        reward_min = torch.min(non_aborted_sequence_reward).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("All samples are aborted, returning default reward metrics")
        reward_mean = reward_max = reward_min = float("nan")

    valid_adv = torch.masked_select(advantages, response_mask)
    valid_returns = torch.masked_select(returns, response_mask)

    if valid_adv.numel() > 0:
        adv_mean = torch.mean(valid_adv).detach().item()
        adv_max = torch.max(valid_adv).detach().item()
        adv_min = torch.min(valid_adv).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("Response mask is all False, returning default advantage metrics")
        adv_mean = adv_max = adv_min = float("nan")

    if valid_returns.numel() > 0:
        returns_mean = torch.mean(valid_returns).detach().item()
        returns_max = torch.max(valid_returns).detach().item()
        returns_min = torch.min(valid_returns).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("Response mask is all False, returning default return metrics")
        returns_mean = returns_max = returns_min = float("nan")

    # Aborted samples and non-aborted response length statistics
    # response_length_non_aborted/*: statistics computed on non-aborted samples only
    aborted_ratio = torch.mean(aborted_mask.float()).detach().item()

    non_aborted_response_length = response_length[non_aborted_mask]
    if non_aborted_response_length.numel() > 0:
        non_aborted_response_length_mean = torch.mean(non_aborted_response_length).detach().item()
        non_aborted_response_length_max = torch.max(non_aborted_response_length).detach().item()
        non_aborted_response_length_min = torch.min(non_aborted_response_length).detach().item()
        non_aborted_response_length_clip_ratio = (
            torch.mean(torch.eq(non_aborted_response_length, max_response_length).float()).detach().item()
        )
    else:
        logger.warning("All samples are aborted, returning default response length metrics")
        non_aborted_response_length_mean = float("nan")
        non_aborted_response_length_max = float("nan")
        non_aborted_response_length_min = float("nan")
        non_aborted_response_length_clip_ratio = float("nan")

    if use_critic:
        values = batch.batch["values"]
        valid_values = torch.masked_select(values, response_mask)
        if valid_returns.numel() > 0 and valid_values.numel() > 0:
            return_diff_var = torch.var(valid_returns - valid_values)
            return_var = torch.var(valid_returns)
            critic_value_metrics = {
                # values
                "critic/values/mean": torch.mean(valid_values).detach().item(),
                "critic/values/max": torch.max(valid_values).detach().item(),
                "critic/values/min": torch.min(valid_values).detach().item(),
                # vf explained var
                "critic/vf_explained_var": (1.0 - return_diff_var / (return_var + 1e-5)).detach().item(),
            }
        else:
            logger.warning("Response mask is all False, returning default value metrics")
            critic_value_metrics = {
                "critic/values/mean": float("nan"),
                "critic/values/max": float("nan"),
                "critic/values/min": float("nan"),
                # vf explained var
                "critic/vf_explained_var": float("nan"),
            }
    else:
        critic_value_metrics = {}

    metrics = {
        # score
        "critic/score/mean": score_mean,
        "critic/score/max": score_max,
        "critic/score/min": score_min,
        # reward
        "critic/rewards/mean": reward_mean,
        "critic/rewards/max": reward_max,
        "critic/rewards/min": reward_min,
        # adv
        "critic/advantages/mean": adv_mean,
        "critic/advantages/max": adv_max,
        "critic/advantages/min": adv_min,
        # returns
        "critic/returns/mean": returns_mean,
        "critic/returns/max": returns_max,
        "critic/returns/min": returns_min,
        **critic_value_metrics,
        # response length
        "response_length/mean": torch.mean(response_length).detach().item(),
        "response_length/max": torch.max(response_length).detach().item(),
        "response_length/min": torch.min(response_length).detach().item(),
        "response_length/clip_ratio": torch.mean(torch.eq(response_length, max_response_length).float())
        .detach()
        .item(),
        # response length (non-aborted only)
        # These statistics exclude aborted samples to avoid skew from zeros
        "response_length_non_aborted/mean": non_aborted_response_length_mean,
        "response_length_non_aborted/max": non_aborted_response_length_max,
        "response_length_non_aborted/min": non_aborted_response_length_min,
        "response_length_non_aborted/clip_ratio": non_aborted_response_length_clip_ratio,
        # aborted ratio
        # Fraction of samples whose response length is zero
        "response/aborted_ratio": aborted_ratio,
        # prompt length
        "prompt_length/mean": torch.mean(prompt_length).detach().item(),

82	    Args:
83	        data_files (str or list): Path(s) to Parquet file(s).
84	        tokenizer (PreTrainedTokenizer): For the tokenization of text to token IDs.
85	        config (DictConfig): Options like cache_dir, prompt_key, max_prompt_length, truncation, etc.
86	        processor (ProcessorMixin, optional): Multimodal preprocessor for images/videos.
87	    """
88	
89	    def __init__(
90	        self,
91	        data_files: str | list[str],
92	        tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizer,
93	        config: DictConfig,
94	        processor: Optional[ProcessorMixin] = None,
95	        max_samples: int = -1,
96	    ):
97	        if not isinstance(data_files, list | ListConfig):
98	            data_files = [data_files]
99	
100	        self.data_files = copy.deepcopy(data_files)
101	        self.original_data_files = copy.deepcopy(data_files)  # use for resume
102	        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
103	        self.processor = processor
104	        self.max_samples = max_samples
105	        self.config = config
106	
107	        self.cache_dir = os.path.expanduser(config.get("cache_dir", "~/.cache/verl/rlhf"))
108	        self.prompt_key = config.get("prompt_key", "prompt")
109	        self.image_key = config.get("image_key", "images")
110	        self.video_key = config.get("video_key", "videos")
111	        self.audio_key = config.get("audio_key", "audios")
112	        # Default to the processor's real patch_size to align with the rollout path.
113	        _default_patch_size = getattr(getattr(self.processor, "image_processor", None), "patch_size", 14)
114	        self.image_patch_size = config.get("image_patch_size") or _default_patch_size
115	        self.max_prompt_length = config.get("max_prompt_length", 1024)
116	        self.return_raw_chat = config.get("return_raw_chat", False)
117	        self.return_full_prompt = config.get("return_full_prompt", False)
118	        self.truncation = config.get("truncation", "error")
119	        self.filter_overlong_prompts = config.get("filter_overlong_prompts", True)
120	        self.apply_chat_template_kwargs = config.get("apply_chat_template_kwargs", {})
121	        self.mm_processor_kwargs = config.get("mm_processor_kwargs", {})
122	
123	        # Mirror AgentLoopWorker's tool loading so length filtering sees the
124	        # same schemas the rollout will.
125	        self.tool_config_path = config.get("tool_config_path", None)
126	        self.function_tool_path = config.get("function_tool_path", None)
127	        self.tool_schemas = None
128	        if self.tool_config_path or self.function_tool_path:
129	            try:
130	                from verl.tools.tool_registry import load_all_tools
131	
132	                tool_list = load_all_tools(
133	                    tool_config_path=self.tool_config_path,
134	                    function_tool_path=self.function_tool_path,
135	                )
136	                self.tool_schemas = [
137	                    tool.tool_schema.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True) for tool in tool_list
138	                ]
139	            except Exception as e:
140	                logger.warning(
141	                    "Failed to initialize tools (tool_config_path=%s, function_tool_path=%s): %s",
142	                    self.tool_config_path,
143	                    self.function_tool_path,
144	                    e,
145	                )
146	                self.tool_schemas = None
147	
148	        self.num_workers = config.get("filter_overlong_prompts_workers", max(1, os.cpu_count() // 4))
149	        self.num_workers = min(self.num_workers, os.cpu_count()) if self.num_workers is not None else None
150	        self.use_shm = config.get("use_shm", False)
151	        self.chat_template_func = config.get("chat_template_func", None)
152	        self.need_tools_kwargs = config.get("need_tools_kwargs", False)
153	        self.filter_prompts = config.get("filter_prompts", True)
154	        self.serialize_dataset = False
155	        self.return_multi_modal_inputs = config.get("return_multi_modal_inputs", True)
156	        self.shuffle = config.get("shuffle", False)
157	        self.seed = config.get("seed")
158	
159	        self._download()
160	        self._read_files_and_tokenize()
161	
162	    def _download(self, use_origin_parquet=False):
163	        from verl.utils.fs import copy_to_local
164	
165	        data_files = self.data_files if not use_origin_parquet else self.original_data_files
166	        for i, parquet_file in enumerate(data_files):
167	            self.data_files[i] = copy_to_local(src=parquet_file, cache_dir=self.cache_dir, use_shm=self.use_shm)
168	
169	    def _read_files_and_tokenize(self):
170	        dataframes = []
171	        for parquet_file in self.data_files:
172	            # read files and cache
173	            if parquet_file.endswith(".parquet"):
174	                dataframe = datasets.load_dataset("parquet", data_files=parquet_file)["train"]
175	            elif parquet_file.endswith(".json") or parquet_file.endswith(".jsonl"):
176	                dataframe = datasets.load_dataset("json", data_files=parquet_file)["train"]
177	            else:
178	                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {parquet_file}")
179	            dataframes.append(dataframe)
180	        self.dataframe: datasets.Dataset = datasets.concatenate_datasets(dataframes)
181	
182	        total = len(self.dataframe)
183	        print(f"dataset len: {len(self.dataframe)}")
184	
185	        if self.max_samples > 0 and self.max_samples < total:
186	            if self.shuffle:
187	                rngs_args = (self.seed,) if self.seed is not None else ()
188	                rng = np.random.default_rng(*rngs_args)
189	                indices = rng.choice(total, size=self.max_samples, replace=False)
190	            else:
191	                indices = np.arange(self.max_samples)
192	            self.dataframe = self.dataframe.select(indices.tolist())
193	            print(f"selected {self.max_samples} random samples out of {total}")
194	
195	        self.dataframe = self.maybe_filter_out_long_prompts(self.dataframe)
196	
197	    def maybe_filter_out_long_prompts(self, dataframe: datasets.Dataset = None):
198	        # filter out too long prompts
199	        if self.filter_overlong_prompts:
200	            tokenizer = self.tokenizer
201	            processor = self.processor
202	            prompt_key = self.prompt_key
203	
204	            if processor is not None:
205	
206	                def doc2len(doc) -> int:
207	                    try:
208	                        messages = self._build_messages(doc, key=self.prompt_key)
209	                        # pass tool schemas if available so the processor can format prompts
210	                        apply_kwargs = dict(**self.apply_chat_template_kwargs)
211	                        if self.tool_schemas is not None:
212	                            apply_kwargs["tools"] = self.tool_schemas
213	
214	                        raw_prompt = self.processor.apply_chat_template(
215	                            messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False, **apply_kwargs
216	                        )
217	                        images, videos, audios = self._process_multi_modal_info(
218	                            messages, self.image_patch_size, self.config
219	                        )

221	                            # only text prompt

223	                                processor.tokenizer(

225	                                    add_special_tokens=False,  # avoid adding special tokens
226	                                    return_attention_mask=False,
227	                                )["input_ids"]
228	                            )
229	                        else:
230	                            # multi-modal prompt
231	                            return len(
232	                                build_multimodal_processor_inputs(
233	                                    processor,
234	                                    text=[raw_prompt],
235	                                    images=images,
236	                                    videos=videos,
237	                                    audio=audios,
238	                                    mm_processor_kwargs=self.mm_processor_kwargs,
239	                                )["input_ids"][0]
240	                            )
241	                    except Exception:
242	                        print("Error processing one of the samples, skipping...")
243	                        traceback.print_exc()
244	                        return self.max_prompt_length + 1
245	
246	            else:
247	
248	                def doc2len(doc) -> int:
249	                    try:
250	                        apply_kwargs = dict(**self.apply_chat_template_kwargs)
251	                        if self.tool_schemas is not None:
252	                            apply_kwargs["tools"] = self.tool_schemas
253	
254	                        # Keep explicit tokenization to avoid transformers version default changes.
255	                        apply_kwargs.pop("tokenize", None)
256	                        apply_kwargs.pop("return_dict", None)
257	                        apply_kwargs.pop("return_tensors", None)
258	
259	                        tokenized_prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
260	                            doc[prompt_key], add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=True, **apply_kwargs
261	                        )
262	                        return len(normalize_token_ids(tokenized_prompt))
263	                    except Exception:
264	                        print("Error processing one of the samples, skipping...")
265	                        traceback.print_exc()
266	                        return self.max_prompt_length + 1
267	
268	            dataframe = dataframe.filter(

- Supports resuming from checkpoints.

    Args:
        data_files (str or list): Path(s) to Parquet file(s).
        tokenizer (PreTrainedTokenizer): For the tokenization of text to token IDs.
        config (DictConfig): Options like cache_dir, prompt_key, max_prompt_length, truncation, etc.
        processor (ProcessorMixin, optional): Multimodal preprocessor for images/videos.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data_files: str | list[str],
        tokenizer: PreTrainedTokenizer,
        config: DictConfig,
        processor: Optional[ProcessorMixin] = None,
        max_samples: int = -1,
    ):
        if not isinstance(data_files, list | ListConfig):
            data_files = [data_files]

        self.data_files = copy.deepcopy(data_files)
        self.original_data_files = copy.deepcopy(data_files)  # use for resume
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.processor = processor
        self.max_samples = max_samples
        self.config = config

        self.cache_dir = os.path.expanduser(config.get("cache_dir", "~/.cache/verl/rlhf"))
        self.prompt_key = config.get("prompt_key", "prompt")
        self.image_key = config.get("image_key", "images")
        self.video_key = config.get("video_key", "videos")
        self.audio_key = config.get("audio_key", "audios")
        # Default to the processor's real patch_size to align with the rollout path.
        _default_patch_size = getattr(getattr(self.processor, "image_processor", None), "patch_size", 14)
        self.image_patch_size = config.get("image_patch_size") or _default_patch_size
        self.max_prompt_length = config.get("max_prompt_length", 1024)
        self.return_raw_chat = config.get("return_raw_chat", False)
        self.return_full_prompt = config.get("return_full_prompt", False)
        self.truncation = config.get("truncation", "error")
        self.filter_overlong_prompts = config.get("filter_overlong_prompts", True)
        self.apply_chat_template_kwargs = config.get("apply_chat_template_kwargs", {})
        self.mm_processor_kwargs = config.get("mm_processor_kwargs", {})

        # Mirror AgentLoopWorker's tool loading so length filtering sees the
        # same schemas the rollout will.
        self.tool_config_path = config.get("tool_config_path", None)
        self.function_tool_path = config.get("function_tool_path", None)
        self.tool_schemas = None
        if self.tool_config_path or self.function_tool_path:
            try:
                from verl.tools.tool_registry import load_all_tools

                tool_list = load_all_tools(
                    tool_config_path=self.tool_config_path,
                    function_tool_path=self.function_tool_path,
                )
                self.tool_schemas = [
                    tool.tool_schema.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True) for tool in tool_list
                ]
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(
                    "Failed to initialize tools (tool_config_path=%s, function_tool_path=%s): %s",
                    self.tool_config_path,
                    self.function_tool_path,
                    e,
                )
                self.tool_schemas = None

        self.num_workers = config.get("filter_overlong_prompts_workers", max(1, os.cpu_count() // 4))
        self.num_workers = min(self.num_workers, os.cpu_count()) if self.num_workers is not None else None
        self.use_shm = config.get("use_shm", False)
        self.chat_template_func = config.get("chat_template_func", None)
        self.need_tools_kwargs = config.get("need_tools_kwargs", False)
        self.filter_prompts = config.get("filter_prompts", True)
        self.serialize_dataset = False
        self.return_multi_modal_inputs = config.get("return_multi_modal_inputs", True)
        self.shuffle = config.get("shuffle", False)
        self.seed = config.get("seed")

        self._download()
        self._read_files_and_tokenize()

    def _download(self, use_origin_parquet=False):
        from verl.utils.fs import copy_to_local

        data_files = self.data_files if not use_origin_parquet else self.original_data_files
        for i, parquet_file in enumerate(data_files):
            self.data_files[i] = copy_to_local(src=parquet_file, cache_dir=self.cache_dir, use_shm=self.use_shm)

    def _read_files_and_tokenize(self):
        dataframes = []
        for parquet_file in self.data_files:
            # read files and cache
            if parquet_file.endswith(".parquet"):
                dataframe = datasets.load_dataset("parquet", data_files=parquet_file)["train"]
            elif parquet_file.endswith(".json") or parquet_file.endswith(".jsonl"):
                dataframe = datasets.load_dataset("json", data_files=parquet_file)["train"]
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {parquet_file}")
            dataframes.append(dataframe)
        self.dataframe: datasets.Dataset = datasets.concatenate_datasets(dataframes)

        total = len(self.dataframe)
        print(f"dataset len: {len(self.dataframe)}")

        if self.max_samples > 0 and self.max_samples < total:
            if self.shuffle:
                rngs_args = (self.seed,) if self.seed is not None else ()
                rng = np.random.default_rng(*rngs_args)
                indices = rng.choice(total, size=self.max_samples, replace=False)
            else:
                indices = np.arange(self.max_samples)
            self.dataframe = self.dataframe.select(indices.tolist())
            print(f"selected {self.max_samples} random samples out of {total}")

        self.dataframe = self.maybe_filter_out_long_prompts(self.dataframe)

    def maybe_filter_out_long_prompts(self, dataframe: datasets.Dataset = None):
        # filter out too long prompts
        if self.filter_overlong_prompts:
            tokenizer = self.tokenizer
            processor = self.processor
            prompt_key = self.prompt_key

            if processor is not None:

                def doc2len(doc) -> int:
                    try:
                        messages = self._build_messages(doc, key=self.prompt_key)
                        # pass tool schemas if available so the processor can format prompts
                        apply_kwargs = dict(**self.apply_chat_template_kwargs)
                        if self.tool_schemas is not None:
                            apply_kwargs["tools"] = self.tool_schemas

                        raw_prompt = self.processor.apply_chat_template(
                            messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False, **apply_kwargs
                        )
                        images, videos, audios = self._process_multi_modal_info(
                            messages, self.image_patch_size, self.config
                        )
                        if images is None and videos is None and audios is None:
                            # only text prompt
                            return len(
                                processor.tokenizer(
                                    text=raw_prompt,
                                    add_special_tokens=False,  # avoid adding special tokens
                                    return_attention_mask=False,
                                )["input_ids"]
                            )
                        else:
                            # multi-modal prompt
                            return len(
                                build_multimodal_processor_inputs(
                                    processor,
                                    text=[raw_prompt],
                                    images=images,
                                    videos=videos,
                                    audio=audios,
                                    mm_processor_kwargs=self.mm_processor_kwargs,
                                )["input_ids"][0]
                            )
                    except Exception:
                        print("Error processing one of the samples, skipping...")
                        traceback.print_exc()
                        return self.max_prompt_length + 1

            else:

                def doc2len(doc) -> int:
                    try:
                        apply_kwargs = dict(**self.apply_chat_template_kwargs)
                        if self.tool_schemas is not None:
                            apply_kwargs["tools"] = self.tool_schemas

                        # Keep explicit tokenization to avoid transformers version default changes.
                        apply_kwargs.pop("tokenize", None)
                        apply_kwargs.pop("return_dict", None)
                        apply_kwargs.pop("return_tensors", None)

                        tokenized_prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
                            doc[prompt_key], add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=True, **apply_kwargs
                        )
                        return len(normalize_token_ids(tokenized_prompt))
                    except Exception:
                        print("Error processing one of the samples, skipping...")
                        traceback.print_exc()
                        return self.max_prompt_length + 1

            dataframe = dataframe.filter(
                lambda doc: doc2len(doc) <= self.max_prompt_length,
                num_proc=self.num_workers,
                desc=f"Filtering prompts longer than {self.max_prompt_length} tokens",
            )

            print(f"filter dataset len: {len(dataframe)}")
        return dataframe

    def resume_dataset_state(self):
        self.serialize_dataset = not hasattr(self, "original_data_files")
        # resume dataframe if not it's serialized in data.pt

299	    def _build_messages(self, example: dict, key: str):
300	        """Replace multimodal placeholders in messages with structured content.
301	
302	        This is required by processor.apply_chat_template.
303	        - <image>: {"type": "image", "image": image} or {"type": "image", **image}
304	        - <video>: {"type": "video", "video": video} or {"type": "video", **video}
305	        - <audio>: {"type": "audio", "audio": audio} or {"type": "audio", **audio}
306	
307	        Args:
308	            example: Row dictionary from dataframe.
309	
310	        Returns:
311	            messages: List of messages with replaced placeholder.
312	        """
313	        messages: list = example[key]
314	        # When concatenating multimodal datasets, get will return None for samples without a modality column.
315	        images = example.get(self.image_key, None) or []
316	        videos = example.get(self.video_key, None) or []
317	        audios = example.get(self.audio_key, None) or []
318	
319	        image_offset, video_offset, audio_offset = 0, 0, 0
320	        for message in messages:
321	            if not images and not videos and not audios:
322	                continue
323	            assert self.processor is not None, "processor is needed to process multimodal data"
324	
325	            content = message["content"]
326	            if not isinstance(content, str):
327	                continue
328	
329	            content_list = []
330	            segments = re.split("(<image>|<video>|<audio>)", content)
331	            segments = [item for item in segments if item != ""]
332	            for segment in segments:
333	                if segment == "<image>":
334	                    assert image_offset < len(images), f"image_offset {image_offset} >= len(images) {len(images)}"
335	                    image = images[image_offset]
336	                    if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
337	                        image = image.convert("RGB")
338	                        content_list.append({"type": "image", "image": image})
339	                    elif isinstance(image, dict):
340	                        if "bytes" in image:
341	                            image["image"] = Image.open(BytesIO(image["bytes"]))
342	                        content_list.append({"type": "image", **image})
343	                    elif isinstance(image, str | os.PathLike):
344	                        content_list.append({"type": "image", "image": os.fspath(image)})
345	                    else:
346	                        raise TypeError(
347	                            f"image must be dict, PIL.Image, or path-like, unsupported image type: {type(image)}"
348	                        )
349	                    image_offset += 1
350	                elif segment == "<video>":
351	                    assert video_offset < len(videos), f"video_offset {video_offset} >= len(videos) {len(videos)}"
352	                    video = videos[video_offset]
353	                    if isinstance(video, dict):
354	                        content_list.append({"type": "video", **video})
355	                    elif isinstance(video, str | os.PathLike):
356	                        content_list.append({"type": "video", "video": os.fspath(video)})
357	                    elif isinstance(video, list):
358	                        video = [os.fspath(frame) if isinstance(frame, os.PathLike) else frame for frame in video]
359	                        content_list.append({"type": "video", "video": video})
360	                    else:
361	                        raise TypeError(
362	                            f"video must be dict, list, or path-like, unsupported video type: {type(video)}"
363	                        )
364	                    video_offset += 1
365	                elif segment == "<audio>":
366	                    assert audio_offset < len(audios), f"audio_offset {audio_offset} >= len(audios) {len(audios)}"
367	                    audio = audios[audio_offset]
368	                    if isinstance(audio, dict):
369	                        payload = dict(audio)
370	                        payload["type"] = "audio"
371	                        if "audio" not in payload and "audio_url" not in payload:
372	                            payload = {"type": "audio", "audio": audio}
373	                        content_list.append(payload)
374	                    else:
375	                        content_list.append({"type": "audio", "audio": audio})
376	                    audio_offset += 1
377	                else:
378	                    content_list.append({"type": "text", "text": segment})
379	            message["content"] = content_list
380	
381	        assert image_offset == len(images), f"image_offset {image_offset} != len(images) {len(images)}"
382	        assert video_offset == len(videos), f"video_offset {video_offset} != len(videos) {len(videos)}"
383	        assert audio_offset == len(audios), f"audio_offset {audio_offset} != len(audios) {len(audios)}"
384	        return messages

414	    async def process_vision_info(
415	        cls,
416	        messages: list[dict],

418	        config: DictConfig,

420	        """Extract images and videos from messages.
421	
422	        This method is called by AgentLoop (e.g SingleTurnAgentLoop) before apply_chat_template to
423	        the `raw_prompt` from dataset. User may customize RLHFDataset and override this method to
424	        support custom vision extraction.
425	
426	        >>> messages = kwargs["raw_prompt"]
427	        >>> images, videos = RLHFDataset.process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size)
428	        >>> videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos)
429	        >>> raw_prompt = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False)
430	        >>> inputs = processor(text=[raw_prompt], images=images, videos=videos,
431	        ...                    video_metadata=video_metadatas, do_sample_frames=False)
432	
433	        Args:
434	            messages: List of messages from dataset `raw_prompt`.
435	            image_patch_size: Image patch size for processor.
436	            config: Config for dataset.
437	
438	        Returns:
439	            images: List of images.
440	            videos: List of videos, each video is a tuple of (video_tensor, video_metadata).
441	        """
442	        from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info
443	
444	        # When called from an AgentLoop, many trajectory coroutines share one
445	        # event loop. ``process_vision_info`` does synchronous PNG decode +
446	        # smart_resize (CPU-heavy); running it inline blocks the loop and starves
447	        # every sibling coroutine's socket I/O (manifests as connect timeouts /
448	        # zero-window stalls under concurrency). Offload to a thread: PIL/numpy
449	        # release the GIL during decode/resize, so the loop stays responsive and
450	        # the work parallelizes across threads. This method is ``async`` and only
451	        # ever awaited from an AgentLoop (which always has a running loop), so
452	        # ``get_running_loop()`` is safe here.
453	        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
454	        images, videos = await loop.run_in_executor(
455	            None,
456	            lambda: process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=image_patch_size, return_video_metadata=True),
457	        )
458	        return images, videos

476	        return audios or None

def __len__(self):
        return len(self.dataframe)

    def _build_messages(self, example: dict, key: str):
        """Replace multimodal placeholders in messages with structured content.

        This is required by processor.apply_chat_template.
        - <image>: {"type": "image", "image": image} or {"type": "image", **image}
        - <video>: {"type": "video", "video": video} or {"type": "video", **video}
        - <audio>: {"type": "audio", "audio": audio} or {"type": "audio", **audio}

        Args:
            example: Row dictionary from dataframe.

        Returns:
            messages: List of messages with replaced placeholder.
        """
        messages: list = example[key]
        # When concatenating multimodal datasets, get will return None for samples without a modality column.
        images = example.get(self.image_key, None) or []
        videos = example.get(self.video_key, None) or []
        audios = example.get(self.audio_key, None) or []

        image_offset, video_offset, audio_offset = 0, 0, 0
        for message in messages:
            if not images and not videos and not audios:
                continue
            assert self.processor is not None, "processor is needed to process multimodal data"

            content = message["content"]
            if not isinstance(content, str):
                continue

            content_list = []
            segments = re.split("(<image>|<video>|<audio>)", content)
            segments = [item for item in segments if item != ""]
            for segment in segments:
                if segment == "<image>":
                    assert image_offset < len(images), f"image_offset {image_offset} >= len(images) {len(images)}"
                    image = images[image_offset]
                    if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
                        image = image.convert("RGB")
                        content_list.append({"type": "image", "image": image})
                    elif isinstance(image, dict):
                        if "bytes" in image:
                            image["image"] = Image.open(BytesIO(image["bytes"]))
                        content_list.append({"type": "image", **image})
                    elif isinstance(image, str | os.PathLike):
                        content_list.append({"type": "image", "image": os.fspath(image)})
                    else:
                        raise TypeError(
                            f"image must be dict, PIL.Image, or path-like, unsupported image type: {type(image)}"
                        )
                    image_offset += 1
                elif segment == "<video>":
                    assert video_offset < len(videos), f"video_offset {video_offset} >= len(videos) {len(videos)}"
                    video = videos[video_offset]
                    if isinstance(video, dict):
                        content_list.append({"type": "video", **video})
                    elif isinstance(video, str | os.PathLike):
                        content_list.append({"type": "video", "video": os.fspath(video)})
                    elif isinstance(video, list):
                        video = [os.fspath(frame) if isinstance(frame, os.PathLike) else frame for frame in video]
                        content_list.append({"type": "video", "video": video})
                    else:
                        raise TypeError(
                            f"video must be dict, list, or path-like, unsupported video type: {type(video)}"
                        )
                    video_offset += 1
                elif segment == "<audio>":
                    assert audio_offset < len(audios), f"audio_offset {audio_offset} >= len(audios) {len(audios)}"
                    audio = audios[audio_offset]
                    if isinstance(audio, dict):
                        payload = dict(audio)
                        payload["type"] = "audio"
                        if "audio" not in payload and "audio_url" not in payload:
                            payload = {"type": "audio", "audio": audio}
                        content_list.append(payload)
                    else:
                        content_list.append({"type": "audio", "audio": audio})
                    audio_offset += 1
                else:
                    content_list.append({"type": "text", "text": segment})
            message["content"] = content_list

        assert image_offset == len(images), f"image_offset {image_offset} != len(images) {len(images)}"
        assert video_offset == len(videos), f"video_offset {video_offset} != len(videos) {len(videos)}"
        assert audio_offset == len(audios), f"audio_offset {audio_offset} != len(audios) {len(audios)}"
        return messages

    def __getitem__(self, item):
        """For rollout, apply_chat_template has been moved to AgentLoop, so we only return raw_prompt here."""
        row_dict: dict = self.dataframe[item]
        row_dict["raw_prompt"] = self._build_messages(row_dict, key=self.prompt_key)

        row_dict.pop(self.image_key, None)
        row_dict.pop(self.video_key, None)
        row_dict.pop(self.audio_key, None)

        # TODO(wuxibin): We still need a dummy tensor to make sure DataProto.batch is not empty.
        # Remove this after deprecate DataProto by TensorDict.
        row_dict["dummy_tensor"] = torch.tensor([0], dtype=torch.uint8)

        # add index for each prompt
        if "extra_info" not in row_dict or row_dict["extra_info"] is None:
            row_dict["extra_info"] = dict()
        index = row_dict.get("extra_info", {}).get("index", 0)
        tools_kwargs = row_dict.get("extra_info", {}).get("tools_kwargs", {})
        interaction_kwargs = row_dict.get("extra_info", {}).get("interaction_kwargs", {})
        need_tools_kwargs = row_dict.get("extra_info", {}).get("need_tools_kwargs", self.need_tools_kwargs)
        if need_tools_kwargs and not tools_kwargs:
            logger.warning("tools_kwargs is empty for index %s, data source: %s", index, row_dict["data_source"])
        row_dict["index"] = index
        row_dict["tools_kwargs"] = tools_kwargs
        row_dict["interaction_kwargs"] = interaction_kwargs
        return row_dict

    @classmethod
    async def process_vision_info(
        cls,
        messages: list[dict],
        image_patch_size,
        config: DictConfig,
    ) -> tuple[list[Image.Image], list[tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]]]:
        """Extract images and videos from messages.

        This method is called by AgentLoop (e.g SingleTurnAgentLoop) before apply_chat_template to
        the `raw_prompt` from dataset. User may customize RLHFDataset and override this method to
        support custom vision extraction.

        >>> messages = kwargs["raw_prompt"]
        >>> images, videos = RLHFDataset.process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size)
        >>> videos, video_metadatas = zip(*videos)
        >>> raw_prompt = processor.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False)
        >>> inputs = processor(text=[raw_prompt], images=images, videos=videos,
        ...                    video_metadata=video_metadatas, do_sample_frames=False)

        Args:
            messages: List of messages from dataset `raw_prompt`.
            image_patch_size: Image patch size for processor.
            config: Config for dataset.

        Returns:
            images: List of images.
            videos: List of videos, each video is a tuple of (video_tensor, video_metadata).
        """
        from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info

        # When called from an AgentLoop, many trajectory coroutines share one
        # event loop. ``process_vision_info`` does synchronous PNG decode +
        # smart_resize (CPU-heavy); running it inline blocks the loop and starves
        # every sibling coroutine's socket I/O (manifests as connect timeouts /
        # zero-window stalls under concurrency). Offload to a thread: PIL/numpy
        # release the GIL during decode/resize, so the loop stays responsive and
        # the work parallelizes across threads. This method is ``async`` and only
        # ever awaited from an AgentLoop (which always has a running loop), so
        # ``get_running_loop()`` is safe here.
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        images, videos = await loop.run_in_executor(
            None,
            lambda: process_vision_info(messages, image_patch_size=image_patch_size, return_video_metadata=True),
        )
        return images, videos

    @classmethod
    def _extract_audio_info(cls, messages: list[dict]) -> list[Any]:
        audios = []
        for message in messages:
            content = message.get("content")
            if not isinstance(content, list):
                continue
            for item in content:
                if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") != "audio":
                    continue
                if "audio" in item:
                    audios.append(item["audio"])
                elif "audio_url" in item:
                    audios.append(item["audio_url"])
                else:
                    audios.append({k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != "type"})
        return audios or None

    @classmethod
    def _process_multi_modal_info(
        cls,
        messages: list[dict],
        image_patch_size,
        config: DictConfig,
    ) -> tuple[list[Image.Image], list[Any], list[Any]]:
        has_visual = any(
            isinstance(message.get("content"), list)
            and any(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") in {"image", "video"} for item in message["content"])
            for message in messages
        )
        if has_visual:
            from qwen_vl_utils import process_vision_info

            images, videos = process_vision_info(
                messages, image_patch_size=image_patch_size, return_video_metadata=True
            )
        else:
            images, videos = None, None
        audios = cls._extract_audio_info(messages)
        return images, videos, audios

    @classmethod
    async def process_multi_modal_info(
        cls,
        messages: list[dict],
        image_patch_size,
        config: DictConfig,
    ) -> tuple[list[Image.Image], list[Any], list[Any]]:
        return cls._process_multi_modal_info(messages, image_patch_size=image_patch_size, config=config)

    def split(self, num_splits: int):
        """
        split the dataset into num_splits sub-datasets
        Args:
            num_splits: specified number of splits
        Returns:
            List[RLHFDataset]: list of RLHFDataset splits
        Raises:
            ValueError: if num_splits is not a positive integer
        """
        if not isinstance(num_splits, int) or num_splits <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"num_splits must be a positive integer, got {num_splits}")

        if not hasattr(self, "dataframe"):
            raise AttributeError(
                "dataframe not found in RLHFDataset\n"
                "reason: _read_files_and_tokenize() not called or Parquet file loading failed"
            )
        if self.dataframe is None:
            raise ValueError("RLHFDataset dataframe 为 None!")

        total_samples = len(self.dataframe)
        print(f"total_samples: {total_samples}")
        if total_samples == 0:
            raise ValueError("Cannot split an empty dataset")

        # Calculate effective sample count after dropping remainders if needed
        if total_samples % num_splits != 0:
            total_samples = total_samples - (total_samples % num_splits)
            logging.warning(f"Dropping {len(self.dataframe) % num_splits} samples, effective samples: {total_samples}")

        split_size = total_samples // num_splits
        splits = []

        for i in range(num_splits):
            start_idx = i * split_size
            end_idx = (i + 1) * split_size if i < num_splits - 1 else total_samples

            split_dataframe = self.dataframe.select(range(start_idx, end_idx))

            split_dataset = RLHFDataset(
                data_files=self.data_files,
                tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
                config=self.config,
                processor=self.processor,
                max_samples=self.max_samples,

   - Metrics: val-core acc/mean@1, critic/rewards, response_length clip_ratio, rollout_corr/*, training/rollout_probs_diff_*, timing, memory

arguments.description: Audit VLM rollout/model path
arguments.prompt:
You are auditing a verl 0.9.0 source tree at /user/user1/harbor-runs/154a053ab079/workspace/verl (python package in subdir `verl/`). This is a READ-ONLY historical snapshot: do not modify any file, do not run training, do not use the network. There is no git history, so you must rely on careful reading and your knowledge of upstream verl to spot a deliberately staged defect/modification (if any).

Context of the run being diagnosed: GRPO on geometry3k with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (vision patch_size 16, spatial_merge_size 2, deepstack visual features, interleaved mrope / 3D position ids), FSDP2 actor with use_remove_padding=True, vLLM async rollout via AgentLoop `single_turn_agent` (rollout.n=5, temperature 1.0, calculate_log_probs=True), validation with val_kwargs do_sample=False temperature=0 n=1. data.image_key=images, data.image_patch_size=16, data.return_multi_modal_inputs=True, return_raw_chat=True. Observed metrics: training/rollout_probs_diff_mean ~0.011-0.013, rollout_probs_diff_max ~0.98-0.9999 every step, pearson ~0.993, rollout_corr/kl ~0.005-0.009; held-out accuracy nearly flat (57.1% -> 59.1% over 20 steps), training reward rising 0.40->0.59.

Your scope — read these files COMPLETELY and carefully (they are the multimodal rollout/training path):
1. verl/experimental/agent_loop/agent_loop.py, single_turn_agent_loop.py, utils.py
2. verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/vllm_async_server.py, vllm_rollout.py, utils.py, weight_update_utils.py
3. verl/workers/rollout/replica.py (and anything under verl/workers/rollout/ that handles multi_modal_data / images / sampling params / val_kwargs)
4. verl/utils/dataset/vision_utils.py
5. verl/models/transformers/qwen3_vl.py, qwen2_vl.py, monkey_patch.py (position ids / mrope / get_rope_index / flash-attention patches / deepstack)
6. verl/utils/model.py (compute_position_id_with_mask, process_multi_modal_inputs / get_rope_index related code), verl/utils/torch_functional.py if referenced for position ids.
7. verl/workers/engine/fsdp/transformer_impl.py and verl/workers/utils/ (anything that builds model inputs: multi_modal_inputs, position_ids, pixel_values, image_grid_thw) and verl/workers/actor/dp_actor.py's _forward_micro_batch (how multi_modal_inputs/position_ids are passed to the HF model).

What to look for (report with file path, line numbers and verbatim code excerpts):
- Any place where the image/vision inputs seen by the vLLM rollout engine could differ from those seen by the FSDP actor/ref forward pass (resize, patch size, min/max pixels, image dropped, image order, grid_thw, pixel_values dtype), or where validation uses different image processing than training.
- Whether validation actually uses greedy decoding (val_kwargs do_sample=False/temperature=0) — trace how sampling params are built for validation vs training in the agent loop / async server.
- Position-id / mrope construction for Qwen3-VL in the actor (e.g., get_rope_index usage, text-only fallback, position_ids shape [3 or 4, bsz, seq]) and in remove-padding path; anything that would make the actor's log-probs systematically wrong (e.g., wrong rope index, off-by-one, image tokens masked incorrectly).
- Weight synchronization from FSDP actor to vLLM (naive checkpoint engine / update_weights): anything that would skip tensors, send stale or wrong weights, skip the vision tower, or transpose/reshape incorrectly.
- Response/eos handling: anything that truncates, drops the last token, or mis-sets response_mask / attention_mask for responses; how rollout log-probs are aligned with tokens.
- Anything that looks hard-coded, commented as a hack, or inconsistent with its own docstring/comments or with tests under tests/ (check tests/ for the corresponding unit tests and whether the code matches them).

Do NOT speculate without evidence; prefer "no anomaly found in X" over inventing problems. Rank your findings by how likely each is to be a deliberately injected defect and explain how each would manifest in the observed metrics above. Your final report should be concise (under 600 words) but include exact file:line references and code excerpts for each finding.

28	@register("single_turn_agent")
29	class SingleTurnAgentLoop(AgentLoopBase):
30	    """Naive agent loop that only do single turn chat completion."""
31	
32	    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
33	        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
34	        self.prompt_length = self.rollout_config.prompt_length
35	        self.response_length = self.rollout_config.response_length
36	
37	    @rollout_trace_op
38	    async def run(self, sampling_params: dict[str, Any], priority: int = 0, **kwargs) -> AgentLoopOutput:
39	        # priority may arrive as np.int64 from non_tensor_batch; normalize to Python int.
40	        priority = int(priority)
41	        messages = list(kwargs["raw_prompt"])
42	
43	        # 1. extract multimodal inputs from messages
44	        multi_modal_data = await self.process_multi_modal_info(messages)
45	        images = multi_modal_data.get("images")
46	        videos = multi_modal_data.get("videos")
47	        audios = multi_modal_data.get("audios")
48	        mm_processor_kwargs = self._get_mm_processor_kwargs(audios)
49	
50	        # 2. apply chat template and tokenize
51	        use_continuous_token = self.enable_continuous_token and not multi_modal_data
52	        if use_continuous_token:
53	            prompt_ids = await self.ct_build_initial_tokens(messages)
54	        else:
55	            prompt_ids = await self.apply_chat_template(
56	                messages,
57	                images=images,
58	                videos=videos,
59	                audios=audios,
60	                mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
61	            )
62	
63	        # 3. generate sequences
64	        metrics = {}
65	        with simple_timer("generate_sequences", metrics):
66	            request_id = f"det-{priority}" if getattr(self.rollout_config, "full_determinism", False) else uuid4().hex
67	            output: TokenOutput = await self.server_manager.generate(
68	                request_id=request_id,
69	                prompt_ids=prompt_ids,
70	                sampling_params=sampling_params,
71	                image_data=images,
72	                audio_data=audios,
73	                video_data=videos,
74	                mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
75	                priority=priority,
76	            )
77	        if metrics.get("num_preempted") is None:
78	            metrics["num_preempted"] = output.num_preempted if output.num_preempted is not None else -1
79	
80	        if use_continuous_token:
81	            merge_result, response_mask, response_logprobs = await self.ct_merge_assistant_token(
82	                prompt_ids,
83	                output.token_ids,
84	                [],
85	                [] if output.log_probs else None,
86	                assistant_logprobs=output.log_probs if output.log_probs else None,
87	            )
88	            response_ids = merge_result.token_ids[-len(response_mask) :] if response_mask else []
89	            prompt_ids = merge_result.token_ids[: len(merge_result.token_ids) - len(response_mask)]
90	        else:
91	            response_ids = output.token_ids
92	            response_mask = [1] * len(output.token_ids)
93	            response_logprobs = output.log_probs
94	
95	        output: AgentLoopOutput = AgentLoopOutput(
96	            prompt_ids=prompt_ids,
97	            response_ids=response_ids[: self.response_length],
98	            response_mask=response_mask[: self.response_length],
99	            response_logprobs=response_logprobs[: self.response_length] if response_logprobs else None,
100	            routed_experts=(
101	                output.routed_experts[: len(prompt_ids) + self.response_length]
102	                if output.routed_experts is not None
103	                else None
104	            ),
105	            multi_modal_data=multi_modal_data,
106	            mm_processor_kwargs=mm_processor_kwargs,
107	            num_turns=2,
108	            metrics=metrics,
109	            extra_fields=output.extra_fields,
110	        )
111	
112	        # keeping the schema consistent with tool_agent_loop
113	        output.extra_fields.update({"turn_scores": [], "tool_rewards": []})
114

131	            # Router replay indexes this field by absolute token position, so it must
132	            # span the whole sequence. The rollout engine records fewer rows than that:
133	            # it only sees tokens fed through the model, and multi-turn loops stop
134	            # recording at the last generation. Trailing rows stay zero; replay masks
135	            # them out instead of consuming them.

206	class AgentLoopBase(ABC):

1269	        timing["agent_loop/tool_calls/max"] = t_tool_calls.max()
1270	        timing["agent_loop/tool_calls/mean"] = t_tool_calls.mean()

1272	        timing["agent_loop/compute_score/max"] = t_compute_score.max()
1273	        timing["agent_loop/compute_score/mean"] = t_compute_score.mean()

18	import hydra

21	
22	from verl.trainer.constants_ppo import get_ppo_ray_runtime_env
23	from verl.trainer.ppo.utils import need_critic, need_reference_policy
24	from verl.utils.config import validate_config
25	from verl.utils.device import auto_set_device, is_cuda_available
26	from verl.utils.import_utils import load_class_from_fqn
27	from verl.utils.logging_utils import configure_verl_logging
28	
29	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
30	logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "INFO"))
31

33	# Define a function to run the PPO-like training process
34	def run_ppo(config, task_runner_class) -> None:
35	    """Initialize Ray cluster and run distributed PPO training process.
36	
37	    Args:
38	        config: Training configuration object containing all necessary parameters
39	                for distributed PPO training including Ray initialization settings,
40	                model paths, and training hyperparameters.
41	        task_runner_class: For recipe to change TaskRunner.
42	    """
43	    # Propagate determinism env vars from config before ray.init() so
44	    # get_ppo_ray_runtime_env() forwards them to all Ray actors.
45	    rollout_cfg = config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout
46	    rm_rollout_cfg = config.reward.reward_model.rollout
47	    if rollout_cfg.full_determinism or (config.reward.reward_model.enable and rm_rollout_cfg.full_determinism):
48	        os.environ["VERL_FULL_DETERMINISM"] = "1"
49	        os.environ["VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT"] = "1"
50	        os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(rollout_cfg.seed)
51	
52	    trainer_logger = config.trainer.get("logger", [])
53	    if "rl_insight" in ([trainer_logger] if isinstance(trainer_logger, str) else trainer_logger or []):
54	        os.environ["VERL_RL_INSIGHT_ENABLE"] = "1"
55	
56	    # Check if Ray is not initialized
57	    if not ray.is_initialized():
58	        # Initialize Ray with a local cluster configuration
59	        # Set environment variables in the runtime environment to control tokenizer parallelism,
60	        # NCCL debug level, VLLM logging level, and allow runtime LoRA updating
61	        # `num_cpus` specifies the number of CPU cores Ray can use, obtained from the configuration
62	        default_runtime_env = get_ppo_ray_runtime_env(config)
63	        ray_init_kwargs = config.ray_kwargs.get("ray_init", {})
64	        runtime_env_kwargs = ray_init_kwargs.get("runtime_env", {})
65	
66	        if config.transfer_queue.enable:
67	            # Add runtime environment variables for transfer queue
68	            runtime_env_vars = runtime_env_kwargs.get("env_vars", {})
69	            runtime_env_vars["TRANSFER_QUEUE_ENABLE"] = "1"
70	            runtime_env_kwargs["env_vars"] = runtime_env_vars
71	
72	        runtime_env = OmegaConf.merge(default_runtime_env, runtime_env_kwargs)
73	        ray_init_kwargs = OmegaConf.create({**ray_init_kwargs, "runtime_env": runtime_env})
74	        print(f"ray init kwargs: {ray_init_kwargs}")
75	        ray.init(**OmegaConf.to_container(ray_init_kwargs))
76	
77	    # Create a remote instance of the TaskRunner class, and
78	    # Execute the `run` method of the TaskRunner instance remotely and wait for it to complete
79	    if (
80	        is_cuda_available
81	        and config.global_profiler.tool == "nsys"
82	        and config.global_profiler.get("steps") is not None
83	        and len(config.global_profiler.get("steps", [])) > 0
84	    ):
85	        from verl.utils.import_utils import is_nvtx_available
86	
87	        assert is_nvtx_available(), "nvtx is not available in CUDA platform. Please 'pip3 install nvtx'"
88	        nsight_options = OmegaConf.to_container(
89	            config.global_profiler.global_tool_config.nsys.controller_nsight_options
90	        )
91	        runner = task_runner_class.options(runtime_env={"nsight": nsight_options}).remote()
92	    else:
93	        runner = task_runner_class.remote()
94	    ray.get(runner.run.remote(config))
95	
96	    # [Optional] get the path of the timeline trace file from the configuration, default to None
97	    # This file is used for performance analysis
98	    timeline_json_file = config.ray_kwargs.get("timeline_json_file", None)
99	    if timeline_json_file:
100	        ray.timeline(filename=timeline_json_file)
101	
102	
103	@ray.remote
104	class TaskRunnerV1:
105	    """V1 TaskRunner for PPO training."""
106	
107	    def __init__(self):
108	        self.config = None
109	        self.trainer = None
110	        self.agent_loop_manager = None
111	
112	    def init_agent_loop_manager(self):
113	        """Initialize the agent loop manager to generate sequences.
114	
115	        NOTE: User can customize their own agent loop manager, the only requirement is:
116	        1. implement `generate_sequences` method
117	        2. put agent loop outputs into TransferQueue
118	        """
119	        from verl.trainer.ppo.v1 import AgentLoopManagerTQ
120	
121	        manager_class_fqn = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.get("agent", {}).get("agent_loop_manager_class")
122	        if manager_class_fqn:
123	            agent_loop_manager_cls = load_class_from_fqn(manager_class_fqn, "AgentLoopManager")
124	        else:
125	            agent_loop_manager_cls = AgentLoopManagerTQ
126	
127	        self.agent_loop_manager = agent_loop_manager_cls.create(
128	            config=self.config,
129	            llm_client=self.trainer.get_llm_client(),
130	            teacher_client=self.trainer.get_teacher_client(),
131	            reward_loop_worker_handles=self.trainer.get_reward_handles(),
132	        )
133	
134	    def run(self, config: DictConfig):
135	        """Run the PPO training process."""
136	        configure_verl_logging()
137	
138	        import transfer_queue as tq
139	
140	        from verl.trainer.ppo.v1 import get_trainer_cls
141	
142	        trainer_cls = get_trainer_cls(config.trainer.v1.trainer_mode)
143	
144	        config.transfer_queue.enable = True
145	        pprint(OmegaConf.to_container(config, resolve=True))
146	        OmegaConf.resolve(config)
147	        self.config = config
148	
149	        # initialize transfer queue
150	        tq.init(config.transfer_queue)
151	        succeeded = False
152	        try:
153	            self.trainer = trainer_cls(config=config)
154	            self.trainer.init()
155	            self.init_agent_loop_manager()
156	            self.trainer.fit(self.agent_loop_manager)
157	            succeeded = True
158	        finally:
159	            try:
160	                tracking = getattr(self.trainer, "logger", None)
161	                if tracking is not None:
162	                    tracking.finish(exit_code=0 if succeeded else 1)
163	            finally:
164	                tq.close()
165	
166	
167	@hydra.main(config_path="config", config_name="ppo_trainer", version_base=None)
168	def main(config):
169	    """Main entry point for PPO training with Hydra configuration management.
170	
171	    Args:
172	        config: Hydra configuration dictionary containing training parameters.
173	    """
174	    # Automatically set `config.trainer.device = npu` when running on Ascend NPU.
175	    auto_set_device(config)
176	
177	    # validate config
178	    validate_config(
179	        config=config,
180	        use_reference_policy=need_reference_policy(config),
181	        use_critic=need_critic(config),
182	    )
183	
184	    if config.trainer.use_v1:
185	        run_ppo(config, task_runner_class=TaskRunnerV1)
186	    else:
187	        from verl.trainer.main_ppo_v0 import TaskRunner
188	
189	        logger.warning(
190	            "Legacy trainer `main_ppo_v0.py` is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0."
191	            "Please set `trainer.use_v1=True` in config to use V1 trainer."
192	        )
193	        run_ppo(config, task_runner_class=TaskRunner)
194	
195	
196	if __name__ == "__main__":
197	    main()
