118	class PPOTrainer(ABC):
119	    """Base class for PPO trainer.
120	
121	    Args:
122	        config: DictConfig from yaml config file.
123	    """
124	
125	    def __init__(self, config: DictConfig):
126	        self.config = config
127	        self.use_critic = need_critic(self.config)
128	        self.use_reference_policy = need_reference_policy(self.config)
129	        self.use_teacher_policy = need_teacher_policy(self.config)
130	        if self.config.algorithm.use_kl_in_reward:
131	            self.kl_ctrl_in_reward = core_algos.get_kl_controller(self.config.algorithm.kl_ctrl)
132	
133	        self.trainer_mode = self.config.trainer.v1.trainer_mode
134	        self.parameter_sync_step = self.config.trainer.v1.get(self.trainer_mode, {}).get("parameter_sync_step", 1)
135	        self.replay_buffer = self._build_replay_buffer()
136	        self._rollout_moe_lb_metrics_accumulator = RolloutMoELoadBalanceMetricsAccumulator(
137	            model_config=self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model
138	        )
139	        # track mini-batch index within a parameter_sync_step cycle for Decoupled PPO
140	        self.local_trigger_step = 0
141	
142	    def _build_replay_buffer(self) -> ReplayBuffer:
143	        """Instantiate the replay buffer (or a user-provided custom sampler).
144	
145	        Set ``trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.{path,name}`` to plug in a custom
146	        ``ReplayBuffer`` subclass; otherwise the built-in implementation is used.
147	        """
148	        sampler_config = self.config.trainer.v1.sampler
149	        custom_sampler = sampler_config.get("custom_sampler", None)
150	        has_custom_sampler = bool(
151	            custom_sampler is not None and custom_sampler.get("path") and custom_sampler.get("name")
152	        )
153	        if has_custom_sampler:
154	            sampler_cls = load_extern_type(custom_sampler.path, custom_sampler.name)
155	        else:
156	            sampler_cls = ReplayBuffer if self.trainer_mode == "sync" else ReplayBufferAsync
157	
158	        replay_buffer_kwargs = dict(
159	            trainer_mode=self.trainer_mode,
160	            trainer_config=self.config.trainer.v1.get(self.trainer_mode, {}),
161	            max_off_policy_threshold=sampler_config.max_off_policy_threshold,
162	            max_off_policy_strategy=sampler_config.max_off_policy_strategy,
163	            sampler_kwargs=sampler_config.sampler_kwargs,
164	            refill_fn=self._add_prompts_to_generate,
165	        )
166	        # Preserve the existing constructor contract for external samplers; custom implementations own
167	        # their filtering semantics and can consume algorithm.filter_groups through their own config.
168	        if not has_custom_sampler:
169	            filter_groups_metric = self._resolve_filter_groups_metric()
170	            sync_refill_failed_groups = bool(sampler_config.get("sync_refill_failed_groups", False))
171	            replay_buffer_kwargs.update(
172	                filter_groups_metric=filter_groups_metric,
173	                sync_refill_failed_groups=sync_refill_failed_groups,
174	            )
175	            if sampler_cls is ReplayBuffer:
176	                filter_groups = self.config.algorithm.get("filter_groups", None)
177	                max_inflight_gen_batches = 1
178	                if filter_groups_metric is not None:
179	                    max_inflight_gen_batches = filter_groups.get("max_inflight_gen_batches", 1)
180	                train_batch_size = self.config.data.train_batch_size
181	                replay_buffer_kwargs.update(
182	                    train_batch_size=train_batch_size,
183	                    gen_batch_size=1
184	                    if filter_groups_metric is not None or sync_refill_failed_groups
185	                    else (self.config.data.get("gen_batch_size", None) or train_batch_size),
186	                    max_inflight_gen_batches=max_inflight_gen_batches,
187	                )
188	        return sampler_cls(**replay_buffer_kwargs)
189	
190	    def _resolve_filter_groups_metric(self) -> str | None:
191	        """Resolve DAPO's group metric and verify that rollout computes it before sampling."""
192	        filter_groups = self.config.algorithm.get("filter_groups", None)
193	        filter_enabled = bool(filter_groups is not None and filter_groups.get("enable", False))
194	        if not filter_enabled:
195	            return None
196	
197	        filter_metric = filter_groups.get("metric", None)
198	        if not filter_metric:
199	            raise ValueError("algorithm.filter_groups.metric must be set when group filtering is enabled")
200	
201	        reward_model = self.config.reward.reward_model
202	        streaming_reward_path = not reward_model.enable or reward_model.enable_resource_pool
203	        assert streaming_reward_path, (
204	            "algorithm.filter_groups requires the reward metric at sampling time: use rule-based reward or "
205	            "reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool=True. A colocated reward model computes rewards only "
206	            "after replay-buffer sampling."
207	        )
208	        max_num_gen_batches = filter_groups.get("max_num_gen_batches", 0)
209	        if max_num_gen_batches > 0:
210	            logger.warning(
211	                "algorithm.filter_groups.max_num_gen_batches=%s is ignored by the built-in V1 ReplayBuffer; "
212	                "use max_inflight_gen_batches to bound concurrent Sync DAPO generation.",
213	                max_num_gen_batches,
214	            )
215	        return str(filter_metric)
216	
217	    def init(self):
218	        """Initialize all components of the trainer.
219	
220	        1. WorkerGroup: actor, critic, reference with model engine: FSDP/Megatron/VeOmni/...
221	        2. LLMServerManager: launch and manage LLM server replicas for generation.
222	        3. CheckpointEngineManager: sync weights between worker group and LLM server replicas.
223	        4. RewardLoopManager: reward workers for rule-based reward, optional LLM server for model-based reward.
224	        5. [Optional] MultiTeacherModelManager: LLM teacher servers for on-policy distillation.
225	        """
226	        self._setup()
227	        self.on_init_end()
228	
229	    def _setup(self):
230	        self._init_tokenizer()
231	        self._init_dataloader()
232	        self._init_dump_executor()
233	        self._init_resource_pool_mgr()
234	        self.resource_pool_manager.create_resource_pool()
235	        self.resource_pool_to_cls = {pool: {} for pool in self.resource_pool_manager.resource_pool_dict.values()}
236	
237	        # 1. define actor and rollout class
238	        actor_role = Role.ActorRolloutRef if Role.ActorRolloutRef in self.role_worker_mapping else Role.ActorRollout
239	        actor_rollout_resource_pool = self.resource_pool_manager.get_resource_pool(actor_role)
240	        actor_rollout_cls = RayClassWithInitArgs(
241	            cls=self.role_worker_mapping[actor_role],
242	            config=self.config.actor_rollout_ref,
243	            distillation_config=self.config.get("distillation"),
244	            role=str(actor_role),
245	        )
246	        self.resource_pool_to_cls[actor_rollout_resource_pool][str(actor_role)] = actor_rollout_cls
247	
248	        # 2. define critic class
249	        if self.use_critic:
250	            critic_cfg: CriticConfig = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.critic)
251	            critic_cfg.engine.infer_max_token_len_per_gpu = critic_cfg.ppo_infer_max_token_len_per_gpu
252	            critic_cfg.engine.max_token_len_per_gpu = critic_cfg.ppo_infer_max_token_len_per_gpu
253	
254	            # Wire the critic profiler config via the hydra path (real dataclass tool_config), so the
255	            # standalone critic TrainingWorker gets a working DistProfiler instead of a silent no-op.
256	            critic_omega_profiler_config = self.config.critic.get("profiler", {})
257	            critic_profiler_config = (
258	                omega_conf_to_dataclass(critic_omega_profiler_config) if critic_omega_profiler_config else None
259	            )
260	
261	            worker_cfg = TrainingWorkerConfig(
262	                model_type="value_model",
263	                model_config=critic_cfg.model,
264	                engine_config=critic_cfg.engine,
265	                optimizer_config=critic_cfg.optim,
266	                checkpoint_config=critic_cfg.checkpoint,
267	                profiler_config=critic_profiler_config,
268	            )
269	            resource_pool = self.resource_pool_manager.get_resource_pool(Role.Critic)
270	            critic_cls = RayClassWithInitArgs(cls=self.role_worker_mapping[Role.Critic], config=worker_cfg)
271	            self.resource_pool_to_cls[resource_pool][str(Role.Critic)] = critic_cls
272	
273	        # 3. create worker group for actor rollout and critic
274	        all_wg = {}
275	        wg_kwargs = {}  # Setting up kwargs for RayWorkerGroup
276	        if OmegaConf.select(self.config.global_profiler, "steps") is not None:
277	            wg_kwargs["profile_steps"] = OmegaConf.select(self.config.global_profiler, "steps")
278	            # Only require nsight worker options when tool is nsys
279	            if OmegaConf.select(self.config.global_profiler, "tool") == "nsys":
280	                assert (
281	                    OmegaConf.select(self.config.global_profiler.global_tool_config.nsys, "worker_nsight_options")
282	                    is not None
283	                ), "worker_nsight_options must be set when using nsys with profile_steps"
284	                wg_kwargs["worker_nsight_options"] = OmegaConf.to_container(
285	                    OmegaConf.select(self.config.global_profiler.global_tool_config.nsys, "worker_nsight_options")
286	                )
287	        wg_kwargs["device_name"] = self.config.trainer.device
288	        logger.info(f"worker group kwargs: {wg_kwargs}")
289	
290	        for resource_pool, class_dict in self.resource_pool_to_cls.items():
291	            if not class_dict:
292	                continue
293	            worker_dict_cls = create_colocated_worker_cls(class_dict=class_dict)
294	            wg_dict = RayWorkerGroup(
295	                resource_pool=resource_pool,
296	                ray_cls_with_init=worker_dict_cls,
297	                **wg_kwargs,
298	            )
299	            spawn_wg = wg_dict.spawn(prefix_set=class_dict.keys())
300	            all_wg.update(spawn_wg)
301	            logger.info(f"create worker group {spawn_wg.keys()}")
302	
303	        # 5. initialize critic model engine
304	        if self.use_critic:
305	            self.critic_wg = all_wg[str(Role.Critic)]
306	            self.critic_wg.reset()
307	            value_loss_ = partial(value_loss, config=critic_cfg)
308	            self.critic_wg.set_loss_fn(value_loss_)
309	            logger.info("critic model engine initialized")
310	
311	        # 6. initialize actor and ref model engine
312	        self.actor_rollout_wg = all_wg[str(actor_role)]
313	        self.actor_rollout_wg.init_model()
314	        logger.info("actor and ref model engine initialized")
315	
316	        # if ref_in_actor is True, the reference policy will be actor without lora applied
317	        lora_rank = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora", {}).get("rank", 0)
318	        if lora_rank <= 0:
319	            lora_rank = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora_rank", 0)
320	        self.ref_in_actor = lora_rank > 0 or self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora_adapter_path") is not None
321	        if self.use_reference_policy and not self.ref_in_actor:
322	            self.ref_policy_wg = all_wg[str(actor_role)]
323	        if self.ref_in_actor:
324	            self.ref_policy_wg = self.actor_rollout_wg
325	
326	        # 7. initialize reward loop manager
327	        resource_pool = (
328	            self.resource_pool_manager.get_resource_pool(Role.RewardModel)
329	            if self.config.reward.reward_model.enable
330	            else None
331	        )
332	        self.reward_loop_manager = RewardLoopManager(
333	            config=self.config,
334	            rm_resource_pool=resource_pool,
335	        )
336	        logger.info("reward loop manager initialized")
337	
338	        # 8. initialize teacher loop manager
339	        if self.use_teacher_policy:
340	            teacher_resource_pool = self.resource_pool_manager.get_resource_pool(Role.TeacherModel)
341	            self.teacher_model_manager = MultiTeacherModelManager(
342	                config=self.config,
343	                resource_pool=teacher_resource_pool,
344	            )
345	            self.distillation_config: DistillationConfig = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.distillation)
346	        else:
347	            self.teacher_model_manager = None
348	            self.distillation_config = None
349	
350	        # 9. initialize agent loop manager
351	        self.llm_server_manager: LLMServerManager = LLMServerManager.create(
352	            config=self.config, worker_group=self.actor_rollout_wg, rollout_resource_pool=actor_rollout_resource_pool
353	        )
354	
355	        # 10. initialize checkpoint engine manager
356	        checkpoint_engine_config = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.checkpoint_engine)
357	        checkpoint_engine_config.backend = "naive"
358	        self.checkpoint_manager: CheckpointEngineManager = CheckpointEngineManager(
359	            config=checkpoint_engine_config,
360	            actor_wg=self.actor_rollout_wg,
361	            replicas=self.llm_server_manager.get_replicas(),
362	        )
363	        logger.info("checkpoint engine manager initialized")
364	
365	        # sleep all replicas to load checkpoint
366	        self.checkpoint_manager.sleep_replicas()
367	        self._load_checkpoint()
368	
369	        logger.info("all initialize finished, ready to fit")
370	
371	    def get_llm_client(self) -> LLMServerClient:
372	        """Get the LLM server client for rollout generation."""
373	        return self.llm_server_manager.get_client()
374

376	        """Get the On-Policy Distillation teacher server clients.

19	def resolve_config_path(config_path: str) -> str:
20	    """Resolve agent loop configuration file path.
21	
22	    In multi-node Ray training, relative paths may not resolve correctly
23	    because the working directory on remote nodes can differ from the driver node.
24	    This function resolves relative paths by checking multiple locations in order:
25	    1. If already absolute, return as-is
26	    2. Try current working directory
27	    3. Try relative to verl package installation (project root)
28	
29	    Args:
30	        config_path: Configuration file path (relative or absolute)
31	
32	    Returns:
33	        Absolute path to the configuration file
34	
35	    Raises:
36	        FileNotFoundError: If the configuration file cannot be found
37	    """
38	    # Return absolute paths unchanged
39	    if os.path.isabs(config_path):
40	        return config_path
41	
42	    # Try current working directory first
43	    cwd = os.path.abspath(os.getcwd())
44	    cwd_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cwd, config_path))
45	    if (cwd_path == cwd or cwd_path.startswith(cwd + os.sep)) and os.path.exists(cwd_path):
46	        return cwd_path
47	
48	    # Try relative to verl project root (where verl package is installed)
49	    try:
50	        import verl
51	
52	        verl_package_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(verl.__file__))
53	
54	        # Strategy 1: For development/editable installs.
55	        project_root = os.path.dirname(verl_package_dir)
56	        dev_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(project_root, config_path))
57	        if (dev_path == project_root or dev_path.startswith(project_root + os.sep)) and os.path.exists(dev_path):
58	            return dev_path
59	
60	        # Strategy 2: For standard package installations.
61	        install_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(verl_package_dir, config_path))
62	        if (install_path == verl_package_dir or install_path.startswith(verl_package_dir + os.sep)) and os.path.exists(
63	            install_path
64	        ):
65	            return install_path
66	    except (ImportError, AttributeError):
67	        pass  # verl not installed or __file__ not available
68	
69	    # File not found - raise clear error
70	    raise FileNotFoundError(
71	        f"Agent loop configuration file not found: {config_path}. Tried current directory and verl project root."
72	    )

75	# tokenizer.apply_chat_template is not working properly for gpt-oss model.

78	def format_gpt_oss_tool_response_manually(tool_response: str, tool_call_name: str) -> str:
79	    """Format tool response for gpt-oss model.
80	    Args:
81	        tool_response: Tool response string
82	        tool_call_name: Name of the tool that was called
83	
84	    Returns:
85	        Formatted tool response string
86	    """
87	    return f"<|start|>functions.{tool_call_name} to=assistant<|channel|>commentary<|message|>{tool_response}<|end|>"
88	
89	
90	def add_generation_prompt_for_gpt_oss(message_content: str) -> str:
91	    """Add generation prompt for gpt-oss model.
92	    Args:
93	        message_content: Message content string
94	
95	    Returns:
96	        Message content string with generation prompt
97	    """
98	    return message_content + "<|start|>assistant"
99	
100	
101	def build_gpt_oss_tool_response_text(messages: list[dict[str, Any]], tool_call_names: list[str]) -> str:
102	    """Build gpt-oss tool response text (manual formatting + generation prompt)."""
103	    tool_response_texts: list[str] = []
104	    for i, tool_msg in enumerate(messages):
105	        actual_tool_name = tool_call_names[i]
106	        formatted = format_gpt_oss_tool_response_manually(tool_msg["content"], actual_tool_name)
107	        tool_response_texts.append(formatted)
108	    return add_generation_prompt_for_gpt_oss("".join(tool_response_texts))

509	    def step(self, metrics: dict, timing_raw: dict) -> KVBatchMeta:
510	        train_batch_size = self.config.data.train_batch_size
511	        assert train_batch_size % self.parameter_sync_step == 0, (
512	            f"train_batch_size ({train_batch_size}) must be divisible by "
513	            f"parameter_sync_step ({self.parameter_sync_step})"
514	        )
515	        sample_batch_size = train_batch_size // self.parameter_sync_step
516	
517	        self._add_batch_to_generate()
518	
519	        metrics_aggregator = MetricsAggregator()
520	        combined_keys: list = []
521	        combined_tags: list = []
522	        combined_partition_id = "train"
523	        for trigger_idx in range(self.parameter_sync_step):
524	            self.local_trigger_step = trigger_idx
525	            iter_metrics: dict = {}
526	            batch = self._step_once(iter_metrics, timing_raw, sample_batch_size)
527	            sample_count = sum(not tag.get("is_padding", False) for tag in batch.tags)
528	            metrics_aggregator.add_step_metrics(iter_metrics, sample_count=sample_count)
529	            combined_keys.extend(batch.keys)
530	            combined_tags.extend(batch.tags)
531	            combined_partition_id = batch.partition_id
532	
533	        metrics.update(metrics_aggregator.get_aggregated_metrics())
534	        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=combined_partition_id, keys=combined_keys, tags=combined_tags)
535	
536	    def _step_once(self, metrics: dict, timing_raw: dict, sample_batch_size: int) -> KVBatchMeta:
537	        """Run a single local update: sample one mini-batch and perform the full PPO pipeline once."""
538	        # 1. sample batch from replay buffer
539	        with marked_timer("gen", timing_raw, color="red"):
540	            self.on_sample_begin()
541	            batch, off_policy_metrics = self.replay_buffer.sample(
542	                global_steps=self.global_steps,
543	                partition_id="train",
544	                batch_size=sample_batch_size,
545	            )
546	            metrics.update(off_policy_metrics)
547	            batch.extra_info["temperature"] = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature
548	            self.on_sample_end()
549	
550	        # 2. [OPTIONAL] compute reward score with colocated reward model
551	        if self.reward_loop_manager.reward_loop_worker_handles is None:
552	            with marked_timer("reward", timing_raw, color="yellow"):
553	                batch = self._compute_reward_colocate(batch, metrics=metrics)
554	
555	        # 3. balance batch across data parallel groups
556	        batch = self._balance_batch(batch, metrics=metrics)
557	
558	        # 4. compute old_log_prob
559	        with marked_timer("old_log_prob", timing_raw, color="blue"):
560	            batch = self._compute_old_log_prob(batch, metrics=metrics)
561	
562	        # 5. [OPTIONAL] compute ref_log_prob
563	        if self.use_reference_policy:
564	            with marked_timer("ref", timing_raw, color="olive"):
565	                batch = self._compute_ref_log_prob(batch, metrics=metrics)
566	
567	        # 6. [OPTIONAL] compute critic values
568	        if self.use_critic:
569	            with marked_timer("values", timing_raw, color="cyan"):
570	                batch = self._compute_values(batch, metrics=metrics)
571	
572	        # 7. compute advantage and return
573	        with marked_timer("adv", timing_raw, color="brown"):
574	            batch = self._compute_advantage(batch, metrics=metrics)
575	
576	        # 8. [OPTIONAL] update critic
577	        if self.use_critic:
578	            with marked_timer("update_critic", timing_raw, color="pink"):
579	                batch = self._update_critic(batch, metrics=metrics)
580	
581	        # 9. update actor
582	        if self.config.trainer.critic_warmup <= self.global_steps:
583	            with marked_timer("update_actor", timing_raw, color="red"):
584	                batch = self._update_actor(batch, metrics=metrics)
585	
586	        return batch

733	    def _init_resource_pool_mgr(self):
734	        config = self.config
735	        # role => worker class
736	        self.role_worker_mapping = {}
737	        # role => resource pool
738	        self.mapping = {}
739	
740	        # Add actor rollout worker to mapping
741	        lora_rank = config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora", {}).get("rank", 0)
742	        if lora_rank <= 0:
743	            lora_rank = config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora_rank", 0)
744	        ref_in_actor = lora_rank > 0 or config.actor_rollout_ref.model.get("lora_adapter_path") is not None
745	
746	        role = Role.ActorRolloutRef if need_reference_policy(config) and not ref_in_actor else Role.ActorRollout
747	        self.role_worker_mapping[role] = ray.remote(ActorRolloutRefWorker)
748	        self.mapping[role] = "global_pool"
749	
750	        # Add critic worker to mapping.
751	        if need_critic(config):
752	            self.role_worker_mapping[Role.Critic] = ray.remote(TrainingWorker)
753	            self.mapping[Role.Critic] = "global_pool"
754	
755	        # Global resource pool is used for actor, rollout, critic, ref
756	        global_pool_id = "global_pool"
757	        resource_pool_spec = {
758	            global_pool_id: [config.trainer.n_gpus_per_node] * config.trainer.nnodes,
759	        }
760	
761	        # Add separate resource pool for reward model if enabled
762	        if config.reward.reward_model.enable_resource_pool:
763	            if config.reward.reward_model.n_gpus_per_node <= 0:

542	        # Calculate the maximum possible new tokens based on available context space
543	        # This serves as a safety upper bound. vLLM v0.20+ rejects `max_tokens < 1`
544	        # (see vllm.sampling_params.SamplingParams._verify_args), so we require at
545	        # least one token of headroom to be able to generate at all.
546	        max_possible_tokens = self.config.max_model_len - len(prompt_ids)
547	        if max_possible_tokens < 1:
548	            raise ValueError(
549	                f"Prompt length ({len(prompt_ids)}) leaves no room to generate within the "
550	                f"model's maximum context length ({self.config.max_model_len}); need at least "
551	                f"1 token of headroom."
552	            )
553	
554	        # Determine max_tokens from sampling_params or use configured response_length as default
555	        if "max_tokens" in sampling_params:
556	            max_tokens = sampling_params.pop("max_tokens")
557	        elif "max_new_tokens" in sampling_params:
558	            # support sglang-style 'max_new_tokens' param
559	            max_tokens = sampling_params.pop("max_new_tokens")
560	        else:
561	            # Default to a calculation that considers configured lengths
562	            # Cap max_tokens by response_length to ensure tensor alignment,
563	            # and by remaining budget to prevent OOM in multi-turn rollouts.
564	            max_tokens = min(
565	                self.config.response_length, self.config.prompt_length + self.config.response_length - len(prompt_ids)
566	            )
567	
568	        # Clamp max_tokens to the valid range [1, max_possible_tokens]. The lower bound
569	        # is 1 because vLLM v0.20+ raises VLLMValidationError when max_tokens < 1.
570	        max_tokens = max(1, min(max_tokens, max_possible_tokens))
571	
572	        assert 1 <= max_tokens <= max_possible_tokens, (
573	            f"max_tokens {max_tokens} not in valid range [1, {max_possible_tokens}]"
574	        )
575	        sampling_params["logprobs"] = 0 if sampling_params.pop("logprobs", False) else None
576	        sampling_params.setdefault("repetition_penalty", self.config.get("repetition_penalty", 1.0))
577	        sampling_params.setdefault("ignore_eos", self.config.get("ignore_eos", False))
578	        # Inject per-request seed for deterministic sampling when full_determinism is enabled.
579	        if self.config.full_determinism:
580	            sampling_params.setdefault("seed", self.replica_rank + self.config.seed)
581	
582	        if kv_transfer_params is not None:
583	            extra_args = dict(sampling_params.pop("extra_args", None) or {})
584	            extra_args["kv_transfer_params"] = kv_transfer_params
585	            sampling_params["extra_args"] = extra_args
586	
587	        sampling_params = SamplingParams(max_tokens=max_tokens, **sampling_params)
588	        prompt_ids = qwen2_5_vl_dedup_image_tokens(prompt_ids, self.model_config.processor)
589	        multi_modal_data = {}
590	        if image_data is not None:
591	            multi_modal_data["image"] = image_data
592	        if video_data is not None:
593	            multi_modal_data["video"] = video_data
594	        if audio_data is not None:
595	            multi_modal_data["audio"] = audio_data
596	
597	        prompt_kwargs = {"prompt_token_ids": prompt_ids, "multi_modal_data": multi_modal_data}
598	        if mm_processor_kwargs:
599	            prompt_kwargs["mm_processor_kwargs"] = mm_processor_kwargs
600	        try:
601	            prompt = TokensPrompt(**prompt_kwargs)
602	        except TypeError:
603	            prompt = prompt_kwargs
604	
605	        # Add lora request
606	        lora_request = None
607	        if self.lora_as_adapter:
608	            # Make sure we also check that the lora is already loaded in the engine
609	            lora_loaded = VLLM_LORA_INT_ID in await self.engine.list_loras()
610	            if lora_loaded:

612	                    lora_name=VLLM_LORA_NAME, lora_int_id=VLLM_LORA_INT_ID, lora_path=VLLM_LORA_PATH
613	                )
614	
615	        with RLInsightLogger.trace_state("vllm_generate", state_lane_id=f"replica_{self.replica_rank}"):
616	            generator = self.engine.generate(
617	                prompt=prompt,
618	                sampling_params=sampling_params,
619	                request_id=request_id,
620	                lora_request=lora_request,
621	                priority=priority,
622	            )
623	
624	            # Get final response
625	            final_res: Optional[RequestOutput] = None
626	            async for output in generator:
627	                final_res = output
628	            assert final_res is not None
629	
630	        extra_fields = {"global_steps": self.global_steps}
631	        # Handle abort case: when the request is aborted by pause_generation(abort),
632	        # outputs may be empty. Return empty results with stop_reason="aborted"
633	        # instead of crashing with "IndexError: list index out of range".
634	        if not final_res.outputs:

637	                log_probs=None,
638	                routed_experts=None,
639	                stop_reason="aborted",
640	                extra_fields=extra_fields,
641	            )
642	
643	        extract_prompt_logprobs(
644	            output=final_res,
645	            num_prompt_logprobs=sampling_params.prompt_logprobs,
646	            result_dict=extra_fields,
647	        )
648	        token_ids = final_res.outputs[0].token_ids
649	        log_probs = None
650	        if sampling_params.logprobs is not None:
651	            log_probs = [logprobs[token_ids[i]].logprob for i, logprobs in enumerate(final_res.outputs[0].logprobs)]
652	
653	        routed_experts = None
654	        if self.config.enable_rollout_routing_replay:
655	            routed_experts = final_res.outputs[0].routed_experts
656	
657	        # Determine stop reason from finish_reason
658	        finish_reason = final_res.outputs[0].finish_reason
659	        if finish_reason == "abort":
660	            stop_reason = "aborted"
661	        elif finish_reason in ("stop", "length"):
662	            stop_reason = "completed"
663	        else:
664	            stop_reason = finish_reason  # for more stop reason in the future
665	
666	        num_preempted = None
667	
668	        if hasattr(final_res.outputs[0], "num_preempted"):
669	            num_preempted = final_res.outputs[0].num_preempted
670	
671	        response_kv_transfer_params = getattr(final_res, "kv_transfer_params", None)
672	        if response_kv_transfer_params is not None:
673	            extra_fields["kv_transfer_params"] = response_kv_transfer_params
674	
675	        # Re-key backend spec-decoding stats to the rollout-common names.
676	        if self.config.mtp is not None and self.config.mtp.enable and self.config.mtp.enable_rollout:
677	            spec_decode_stats = getattr(final_res.metrics, "request_spec_decode_stats", None)

682	                        "speculative decoding acceptance metrics will be skipped."
683	                    )
684	                    self._warned_missing_spec_decode_stats = True
685	            else:
686	                extra_fields["spec_num_draft_tokens"] = spec_decode_stats.num_draft_tokens

688	                extra_fields["spec_num_verify_steps"] = spec_decode_stats.num_verify_steps
689	        return TokenOutput(

691	            log_probs=log_probs,
692	            routed_experts=routed_experts,

704	    async def _pd_dispatch(
705	        self,
706	        prompt_ids: list[int],

718	        is_mooncake = connector == "MooncakeConnector"

724	        prefill_sp["max_tokens"] = 1

727	            "do_remote_decode": True,
728	            "do_remote_prefill": False,
729	            "transfer_id": transfer_id,
730	        }

740	            priority=priority,
741	            kv_transfer_params=prefill_kv_params,
742	        )
743	        if is_mooncake:
744	            # Mooncake does not return decode params from the prefill leg.
745	            decode_kv_params = {
746	                "do_remote_decode": False,
747	                "do_remote_prefill": True,
748	                "remote_engine_id": self._pd_prefill_engine_id,
749	                # Single-node PD uses Mooncake's local bootstrap address.
750	                "remote_bootstrap_addr": f"http://127.0.0.1:{self._pd_prefill_side_channel_port}",

752	            }

852	    async def abort_all_requests(self, reset_prefix_cache: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
853	        """Abort all ongoing generation requests.
854	
855	        On vLLM >= 0.12.0, uses AsyncLLM.pause_generation() to abort in-flight
856	        requests, drain, and clear caches. The engine remains paused after this
857	        call — use resume_generation() to accept new requests (e.g. before
858	        validation).
859	
860	        On vLLM < 0.12.0, manually aborts each request and resets prefix cache.
861	
862	        Returns:
863	            dict[str, Any]: Dictionary containing:
864	                - aborted_count: Number of requests aborted
865	                - request_ids: List of aborted request IDs
866	        """
867	        try:
868	            # Snapshot request IDs before pausing for reporting
869	            request_ids = list(self.engine.output_processor.request_states.keys())
870	
871	            # pause_generation with wait_for_inflight_requests=False will:
872	            # 1. Set engine to paused state (blocks new generate calls)
873	            # 2. Abort all in-flight requests
874	            # 3. Wait for requests to drain
875	            # 4. Clear prefix and mm caches if clear_cache=True.
876	            #    EngineCore._reset_caches defaults reset_connector=True
877	            #    on this path, so any attached external KV store (e.g.
878	            #    MooncakeStoreConnector) is invalidated along with the
879	            #    local prefix cache — RL-correct hard-reset at every
880	            #    weight update boundary, no extra kwargs needed.
881	            await self.engine.pause_generation(
882	                wait_for_inflight_requests=False,
883	                clear_cache=reset_prefix_cache,
884	            )
885	
886	            logger.info(f"Aborted {len(request_ids)} requests: {request_ids}")
887	            return {"aborted_count": len(request_ids), "request_ids": request_ids}
888	
889	        except Exception as e:
890	            logger.error(f"Error aborting requests: {e}")
891	            return {"aborted_count": 0, "request_ids": [], "error": str(e)}

847	    def _reissue_inflight_prompts(self, partition_id: str = "train") -> int:
848	        """Restart checkpointed pending/running prompt groups from their persisted prompt data."""
849	        if self.trainer_mode == "sync" or not _tq_supports_checkpoint():
850	            return 0
851	        data = tq.kv_list(partition_id)
852	        if not data:
853	            return 0
854	        items = data.get(partition_id, {})
855	        inflight_uids = [
856	            key
857	            for key, tag in items.items()
858	            if tag.get("is_prompt", False) and tag.get("status") in ("pending", "running")
859	        ]
860	        if not inflight_uids:
861	            return 0
862	
863	        batch = tq.kv_batch_get(keys=inflight_uids, partition_id=partition_id)
864	        inflight_uid_set = set(inflight_uids)
865	        old_trajectory_keys = [
866	            key
867	            for key, tag in items.items()
868	            if not tag.get("is_prompt", False) and key.split("_", 1)[0] in inflight_uid_set
869	        ]
870	        if old_trajectory_keys:
871	            tq.kv_clear(keys=old_trajectory_keys, partition_id=partition_id)
872	
873	        # Treat this as a new dispatch attempt for the resumed training step.
874	        tu.assign_non_tensor_data(batch, "global_steps", self.global_steps)
875	        tags = [{"is_prompt": True, "status": "pending", "global_steps": self.global_steps} for _ in inflight_uids]
876	        tq.kv_batch_put(keys=inflight_uids, partition_id=partition_id, tags=tags)
877	        self.agent_loop_manager.generate_sequences(batch)
878	
879	        logger.info(
880	            f"Re-issued {len(inflight_uids)} in-flight prompts for step {self.global_steps}; "
881	            f"cleared {len(old_trajectory_keys)} old trajectories from partition {partition_id}"
882	        )
883	        return len(inflight_uids)

959	    def _validate(self) -> dict[str, float]:
960	        # Lists to collect samples for the table
961	        sample_uids = []
962	        sample_inputs = []
963	        sample_outputs = []
964	        sample_gts = []
965	        sample_scores = []
966	        sample_turns = []
967	        data_sources = []
968	        reward_extra_infos_dict: dict[str, list] = defaultdict(list)
969	        dump_all_inputs: list[str] = []
970	        dump_all_outputs: list[str] = []
971	        dump_all_keys: list[str] = []
972	        session_to_sample_idx: dict[str, int] = {}
973	
974	        for batch_dict in self.val_dataloader:
975	            # 1. put batch to agent loop manager
976	            batch_dict["uid"] = np.array(
977	                [str(uuid.uuid4()) for _ in range(len(batch_dict["raw_prompt"]))], dtype=object
978	            )
979	            batch = tu.get_tensordict(batch_dict)
980	            tu.assign_non_tensor_data(batch, "global_steps", self.global_steps)
981	            tu.assign_non_tensor_data(batch, "validate", True)
982	            # Register each prompt (GRPO group) in TransferQueue as a tag-only status marker.
983	            # global_steps is required by ReplayBuffer's metadata sync / staleness ordering.
984	            tags = [
985	                {"is_prompt": True, "status": "pending", "global_steps": self.global_steps} for _ in range(len(batch))
986	            ]
987	            tq.kv_batch_put(keys=list(batch["uid"]), partition_id="val", tags=tags)
988	            self.agent_loop_manager.generate_sequences(batch)
989	
990	            # 2. sample batch from replay buffer: one prompt (GRPO group) per submitted row.
991	            batch, _ = self.replay_buffer.sample(
992	                global_steps=self.global_steps, partition_id="val", batch_size=len(batch)
993	            )
994	
995	            # 3. [OPTIONAL] compute reward score with colocated reward model
996	            if self.reward_loop_manager.reward_loop_worker_handles is None:
997	                self.checkpoint_manager.sleep_replicas()
998	                batch = self._compute_reward_colocate(batch)
999	                self.checkpoint_manager.update_weights()
1000	
1001	            # 4. collect necessary data for logging
1002	            # For multi-output agent loops, only use the final output per session for metrics.
1003	            # Keys have format {uid}_{session_id}_{index}; keep only the highest index per session.
1004	            session_max: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # session_key -> (max_index, position)
1005	            for pos, key in enumerate(batch.keys):
1006	                parts = key.rsplit("_", 2)
1007	                if len(parts) == 3:
1008	                    session_key = f"{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}"
1009	                    index = int(parts[2])
1010	                    if session_key not in session_max or index > session_max[session_key][0]:
1011	                        session_max[session_key] = (index, pos)
1012	                else:
1013	                    session_max[key] = (0, pos)
1014	            sorted_sessions = sorted(session_max.items(), key=lambda x: x[1][1])
1015	            final_indices = [pos for _, (_, pos) in sorted_sessions]
1016	            final_keys = [batch.keys[i] for i in final_indices]
1017	            base_offset = len(sample_scores)
1018	            session_to_sample_idx.update(
1019	                {session_key: base_offset + j for j, (session_key, _) in enumerate(sorted_sessions)}
1020	            )
1021	
1022	            text_data = tq.kv_batch_get(
1023	                keys=batch.keys, partition_id=batch.partition_id, select_fields=["prompts", "responses"]
1024	            )
1025	            text_data["prompts"] = text_data["prompts"].to_padded_tensor(padding=self.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
1026	            text_data["responses"] = text_data["responses"].to_padded_tensor(padding=self.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
1027	            all_inputs = [self.tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True) for ids in text_data["prompts"]]
1028	            all_outputs = [self.tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True) for ids in text_data["responses"]]
1029	
1030	            fields = ["uid", "rm_scores", "num_turns", "reward_model", "data_source", "extra_fields"]
1031	            data = tq.kv_batch_get(keys=final_keys, partition_id=batch.partition_id, select_fields=fields)
1032	
1033	            sample_uids.extend(data.pop("uid").tolist())
1034	            sample_outputs.extend(all_outputs[i] for i in final_indices)
1035	            sample_inputs.extend(all_inputs[i] for i in final_indices)
1036	            scores = data["rm_scores"].sum(dim=1).tolist()
1037	            sample_scores.extend(scores)
1038	            sample_turns.extend(data.pop("num_turns").tolist())
1039	            reward_extra_infos_dict["reward"].extend(scores)
1040	
1041	            extra_fields_list = data.pop("extra_fields", None)
1042	            if extra_fields_list is not None:
1043	                n_prior = len(reward_extra_infos_dict["reward"]) - len(extra_fields_list.tolist())
1044	                for extra_field in extra_fields_list.tolist():
1045	                    reward_extra_info = (
1046	                        extra_field.get("reward_extra_info", {}) if isinstance(extra_field, dict) else {}
1047	                    )
1048	                    for key in reward_extra_infos_dict:
1049	                        if key != "reward" and key not in reward_extra_info:
1050	                            reward_extra_infos_dict[key].append(None)
1051	                    for key, value in reward_extra_info.items():
1052	                        if key not in reward_extra_infos_dict:
1053	                            reward_extra_infos_dict[key] = [None] * n_prior
1054	                        reward_extra_infos_dict[key].append(value)
1055	                    n_prior += 1
1056	
1057	            reward_model = data.pop("reward_model", None)
1058	            if reward_model is not None:
1059	                sample_gts.extend([item.get("ground_truth", None) for item in reward_model.tolist()])
1060	            else:
1061	                sample_gts.extend([None] * len(final_indices))
1062	
1063	            data_source = data.pop("data_source", None)
1064	            if data_source is not None:
1065	                data_sources.extend(data_source.tolist())
1066	            else:
1067	                data_sources.extend(["unknown"] * len(final_indices))
1068	
1069	            dump_all_inputs.extend(all_inputs)
1070	            dump_all_outputs.extend(all_outputs)
1071	            dump_all_keys.extend(batch.keys)
1072	
1073	            # 5. cleanup transfer queue
1074	            tq.kv_clear(keys=batch.keys, partition_id=batch.partition_id)
1075	
1076	        # logger to wandb
1077	        self._maybe_log_val_generations(inputs=sample_inputs, outputs=sample_outputs, scores=sample_scores)
1078	
1079	        # dump to local dir
1080	        val_data_dir = self.config.trainer.get("validation_data_dir", None)
1081	        if val_data_dir:
1082	            # Sort according to uid (so that generations in the same rollout are together)
1083	            sort_keys = []
1084	            for key in dump_all_keys:
1085	                parts = key.rsplit("_", 2)
1086	                sort_keys.append((parts[0], int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])) if len(parts) == 3 else (key, 0, 0))
1087	            sorted_indices = sorted(range(len(dump_all_keys)), key=lambda i: sort_keys[i])
1088	            dump_all_inputs = [dump_all_inputs[i] for i in sorted_indices]
1089	            dump_all_outputs = [dump_all_outputs[i] for i in sorted_indices]
1090	            dump_all_keys = [dump_all_keys[i] for i in sorted_indices]
1091	
1092	            # For ground truths, scores and reward extra infos, find the values in the
1093	            # lists for the final samples of each session
1094	            dump_all_sessions = [
1095	                f"{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}" if len(parts) == 3 else key
1096	                for key in dump_all_keys
1097	                for parts in [key.rsplit("_", 2)]
1098	            ]
1099	            session_final_indices = [session_to_sample_idx[session] for session in dump_all_sessions]
1100	            self._dump_generations(
1101	                inputs=dump_all_inputs,
1102	                outputs=dump_all_outputs,
1103	                gts=[sample_gts[i] for i in session_final_indices],
1104	                scores=[sample_scores[i] for i in session_final_indices],
1105	                reward_extra_infos_dict={
1106	                    k: [v[i] for i in session_final_indices] for k, v in reward_extra_infos_dict.items()
1107	                }
1108	                | {"uid": dump_all_keys},
1109	                dump_path=val_data_dir,
1110	            )
1111	
1112	        return self._val_metrics_update(data_sources, sample_uids, reward_extra_infos_dict, sample_turns)

1117	        if generations_to_log == 0:
1118	            return
1119	
1120	        # Create tuples of (input, output, score) and sort by input text
1121	        samples = list(zip(inputs, outputs, scores, strict=True))
1122	        samples.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])  # Sort by input text
1123	
1124	        # Use fixed random seed for deterministic shuffling

1135	    def _write_generations(inputs, outputs, gts, scores, reward_extra_infos_dict, dump_path, global_steps):
1136	        """Write generation samples as JSONL (runs in background thread)."""
1137	        os.makedirs(dump_path, exist_ok=True)
1138	        filename = os.path.join(dump_path, f"{global_steps}.jsonl")
1139	
1140	        n = len(inputs)
1141	        base_data = {
1142	            "input": inputs,
1143	            "output": outputs,
1144	            "gts": gts,
1145	            "score": scores,
1146	            "step": [global_steps] * n,
1147	        }
1148	
1149	        for k, v in reward_extra_infos_dict.items():
1150	            if len(v) == n:
1151	                base_data[k] = v
1152	
1153	        def json_encode_default(obj):
1154	            if isinstance(obj, np.integer):
1155	                return int(obj)
1156	            elif isinstance(obj, np.floating):
1157	                return float(obj)
1158	            elif isinstance(obj, np.bool_):
1159	                return bool(obj)
1160	            elif hasattr(obj, "tolist"):
1161	                return obj.tolist()
1162	            raise TypeError(f"Object of type {type(obj).__name__} is not JSON serializable")
1163	
1164	        with open(filename, "w") as f:
1165	            for i in range(n):
1166	                entry = {k: v[i] for k, v in base_data.items()}
1167	                f.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, default=json_encode_default) + "\n")
1168	
1169	        print(f"Dumped generations to {filename}")

1171	    def _dump_generations(self, inputs, outputs, gts, scores, reward_extra_infos_dict, dump_path):
1172	        """Dump rollout/validation samples as JSONL asynchronously."""
1173	        global_steps = self.global_steps
1174	        future = self._dump_executor.submit(
1175	            self._write_generations,
1176	            inputs,
1177	            outputs,
1178	            gts,
1179	            scores,
1180	            reward_extra_infos_dict,
1181	            dump_path,
1182	            global_steps,
1183	        )
1184	        self._dump_futures.append(future)
1185	        # Clean up completed futures and surface any exceptions early
1186	        still_pending = []
1187	        for f in self._dump_futures:
1188	            if f.done():
1189	                f.result()  # re-raises if the write failed
1190	            else:
1191	                still_pending.append(f)
1192	        self._dump_futures = still_pending

899	    async def abort_request(self, request_id: str, reset_prefix_cache: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
900	        """Abort a specific generation request.
901	
902	        Args:
903	            request_id: The ID of the request to abort.
904	
905	        Returns:
906	            dict[str, Any]: Dictionary containing abort result.
907	        """
908	        try:
909	            request_states = self.engine.output_processor.request_states
910	            req_state = request_states.get(request_id)
911	
912	            if req_state is None:
913	                return {"aborted": False, "error": f"Request {request_id} not found"}
914	
915	            # Create abort output and put it to the queue
916	            from vllm.v1.engine import FinishReason
917	
918	            request_output = req_state.make_request_output(
919	                [], pooling_output=None, finish_reason=FinishReason.ABORT, stop_reason=None
920	            )
921	            req_state.queue.put(request_output)
922	
923	            # Abort in output processor and engine core
924	            self.engine.output_processor.abort_requests([request_id])
925	            await self.engine.engine_core.abort_requests_async([request_id])
926	
927	            # Try to reset prefix cache to ensure clean state
928	            if reset_prefix_cache:
929	                await self.clear_kv_cache()
930	                logger.info(f"Prefix cache reset after abort request {request_id}")
931	
932	            logger.info(f"Aborted request: {request_id}")
933	            return {"aborted": True, "request_id": request_id}
934	
935	        except Exception as e:
936	            logger.error(f"Error aborting request {request_id}: {e}")
937	            return {"aborted": False, "request_id": request_id, "error": str(e)}

1075	    async def _sleep_hybrid(self):
1076	        """HYBRID sleep: adapters and MTP need level=1; full weights need level=2.
1077	
1078	        Uses engine.sleep() instead of engine.collective_rpc("sleep") to ensure

1081	        leaving other DP shards' weights unreleased, which causes OOM during

1087	            and getattr(mtp_config, "enable", False)

1089	        )
1090	        # MTP drafter-only weights are initialized by vLLM and are not guaranteed
1091	        # to be restored by actor weight sync after level 2 sleep discards them.
1092	        # lora only update adapter weights, so set sleep level to 1
1093	        # vllm_ascend not support sleep_level now. Enabling EP during training may lead to accuracy issues.

1396	        raw_prompts = list(data["raw_prompt"])

1406	        )

1409	        rm_output = self.reward_loop_manager.compute_rm_score(rm_input)

1412	        padded_rm_scores = rm_output.batch["rm_scores"]

1415	            layout=torch.jagged,
1416	        )

1421	            keys=batch.keys,
1422	            partition_id=batch.partition_id,

104	def monkey_patch_compute_logits(model, vocab_size: int, banned_token_ids: Optional[list[int]] = None):
105	    """Mask the tokens the sampler must never pick.

107	    Beyond the out-of-vocabulary tail, `banned_token_ids` covers tokens that live *inside* the
108	    vocabulary yet are still illegal to generate: the vision placeholders, which are meaningless
109	    unless a real image or video sits behind them. See `get_vision_placeholder_token_ids`.
110	    """
111	    original_compute_logits = model.compute_logits

116	        **kwargs,
117	    ) -> torch.Tensor:

120	        if banned_token_ids:

400	    def _get_zmq_handle(self) -> str:
401	        """Get ZMQ handle for communication.
402	
403	        Uses Ray job id + replica_rank + rollout-local rank to match the sender
404	        side and avoid cross-job collisions on shared hosts.

435	def build_cli_args_from_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
436	    """
437	    Convert a config dictionary to CLI arguments for vLLM server.
438	
439	    Handles different value types appropriately:
440	    - None: skipped
441	    - bool True: adds '--key'
442	    - bool False: skipped
443	    - list: expands to '--key item1 item2 ...'
444	    - empty list: skipped (vLLM uses nargs="+" which requires at least one value)
445	    - dict: JSON serialized
446	    - other: string converted
447	
448	    Args:
449	        config: Dictionary of configuration key-value pairs
450	
451	    Returns:
452	        List of CLI argument strings
453	    """
454	    cli_args = []
455	    for k, v in config.items():
456	        if v is None:
457	            continue
458	        if isinstance(v, bool):
459	            if v:
460	                cli_args.append(f"--{k}")
461	        elif isinstance(v, list):
462	            if not v:
463	                # Skip empty lists - vLLM uses nargs="+" which requires at least one value
464	                continue
465	            # Lists need to be expanded as multiple separate arguments
466	            # e.g., --cuda-graph-sizes 1 2 4 8 becomes ['--cuda-graph-sizes', '1', '2', '4', '8']
467	            cli_args.append(f"--{k}")
468	            cli_args.extend([str(item) for item in v])
469	        else:
470	            cli_args.append(f"--{k}")
471	            # Use json.dumps for dict to ensure valid JSON format
472	            cli_args.append(json.dumps(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else str(v))
473	    return cli_args

494	def extract_prompt_logprobs(output: RequestOutput, num_prompt_logprobs: Optional[int], result_dict: dict[str, list]):
495	    """Extract prompt log probabilities from generation output."""
496	    if num_prompt_logprobs is None:
497	        return
498	
499	    prompt_logprobs_ls, prompt_ids_ls = [], []
500	    # NOTE: logprob of first prompt token is None.
501	    for logprobs_dict in output.prompt_logprobs[1:]:
502	        if num_prompt_logprobs == 0:
503	            token_id_str = list(logprobs_dict.keys())[0]
504	            logprob = logprobs_dict[token_id_str].logprob
505	            prompt_logprobs_ls.append([logprob])
506	            prompt_ids_ls.append([int(token_id_str)])
507	        else:
508	            prompt_ids = [None] * num_prompt_logprobs
509	            prompt_logprobs = [None] * num_prompt_logprobs
510	            # We get either top-k logprobs or top-k plus the sampled logprob (if sampled token is not in top-k)
511	            assert len(logprobs_dict) in [num_prompt_logprobs, num_prompt_logprobs + 1], len(logprobs_dict)
512	            for token_id_str, token_logprob in logprobs_dict.items():
513	                rank = token_logprob.rank
514	                if rank > num_prompt_logprobs:
515	                    continue  # the sampled token is not in the top-k
516	                logprob = token_logprob.logprob
517	                prompt_ids[rank - 1] = int(token_id_str)
518	                prompt_logprobs[rank - 1] = logprob
519	            prompt_logprobs_ls.append(prompt_logprobs)
520	            prompt_ids_ls.append(prompt_ids)
521	
522	    # NOTE: pad a dummy prompt logprob for last prompt token.
523	    prompt_logprobs_ls.append([0.0] * max(num_prompt_logprobs, 1))
524	    prompt_ids_ls.append([0] * max(num_prompt_logprobs, 1))
525	
526	    result_dict["prompt_ids"] = prompt_ids_ls
527	    result_dict["prompt_logprobs"] = prompt_logprobs_ls

20	def split_buffer_updates(
21	    model: torch.nn.Module, weights: list[WeightUpdate]
22	) -> tuple[list[WeightUpdate], list[WeightUpdate], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
23	    """Split incoming weight updates into parameter and buffer updates.
24	
25	    Returns the parameter updates, the buffer updates, and the model's
26	    ``named_buffers`` map so callers can reuse it without re-iterating.
27	    """
28	    named_buffers = dict(model.named_buffers())
29	    param_updates, buffer_updates = [], []
30	    for name, tensor in weights:
31	        if name in named_buffers:
32	            buffer_updates.append((name, tensor))
33	        else:
34	            param_updates.append((name, tensor))
35	    return param_updates, buffer_updates, named_buffers
36	
37	
38	@torch.no_grad()
39	def apply_buffer_updates(
40	    model: torch.nn.Module,
41	    buffer_updates: list[WeightUpdate],
42	    named_buffers: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
43	) -> int:
44	    """Copy updated buffer tensors into the target model in-place."""
45	    if not buffer_updates:
46	        return 0
47	
48	    if named_buffers is None:
49	        named_buffers = dict(model.named_buffers())
50	    loaded = 0
51	    for name, tensor in buffer_updates:
52	        if name not in named_buffers:
53	            continue
54	
55	        target = named_buffers[name]
56	        if target.shape != tensor.shape:
57	            raise ValueError(
58	                f"Buffer shape mismatch for {name}: expected {tuple(target.shape)}, got {tuple(tensor.shape)}"
59	            )
60	
61	        source = tensor.to(device=target.device, dtype=target.dtype, non_blocking=False)
62	        target.copy_(source, non_blocking=False)
63	        loaded += 1
64	
65	    return loaded

26	class MetricsAggregator:
27	    """
28	    Combine per-iteration training metrics collected within a single ``parameter_sync_step`` cycle.
29	    Adapted from ``verl.experimental.fully_async_policy.detach_utils.MetricsAggregator`.
30	    """
31	
32	    def __init__(self):
33	        self.metric_values: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
34	        self.metric_weights: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
35	        self.dict_metrics: dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)
36	        self.step_count = 0
37	        self.aggregation_rules = self._init_aggregation_rules()
38	
39	    def _init_aggregation_rules(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
40	        return {
41	            "sum": [
42	                "training/off_policy/evicted_samples",
43	                "validation/off_policy/evicted_samples",
44	                "training/filter_groups/evicted_samples",
45	                "validation/filter_groups/evicted_samples",
46	                "training/filter_groups/discarded_surplus_samples",
47	                "validation/filter_groups/discarded_surplus_samples",
48	                "training/rollout_failure/evicted_samples",
49	                "validation/rollout_failure/evicted_samples",
50	            ],
51	            "last": [
52	                "training/global_step",
53	                "training/rollout_probs_diff_valid",
54	            ],
55	        }
56	
57	    def add_step_metrics(self, metrics: dict[str, Any], sample_count: int = 0):
58	        """Record one iteration's metrics."""
59	        self.step_count += 1
60	        for key, value in metrics.items():
61	            if isinstance(value, bool):
62	                continue
63	            if key == DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY and isinstance(value, dict):
64	                self.dict_metrics[key].update(value)
65	                continue
66	            if isinstance(value, int | float | np.number):
67	                self.metric_values[key].append(float(value))
68	                self.metric_weights[key].append(self._get_metric_weight(key, metrics, sample_count))
69	            elif isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) and value.numel() == 1:
70	                self.metric_values[key].append(float(value.item()))
71	                self.metric_weights[key].append(self._get_metric_weight(key, metrics, sample_count))
72	
73	    def _get_metric_weight(self, metric_name: str, metrics: dict[str, Any], sample_count: int) -> int:
74	        """Return the sample weight used when reducing per-iteration average metrics."""
75	        if metric_name.endswith("/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/mean"):
76	            prefix = metric_name.rsplit("_staleness/mean", 1)[0]
77	            evicted_samples = metrics.get(prefix, sample_count)
78	            if isinstance(evicted_samples, torch.Tensor):
79	                return int(evicted_samples.item()) if evicted_samples.numel() == 1 else sample_count
80	            if isinstance(evicted_samples, int | float | np.number):
81	                return int(evicted_samples)
82	        return sample_count
83	
84	    def _get_aggregation_type(self, metric_name: str) -> str:
85	        for agg_type, metric_list in self.aggregation_rules.items():
86	            if metric_name in metric_list:
87	                return agg_type
88	
89	        metric_lower = metric_name.lower()
90	        if metric_lower.endswith("/lr") or metric_lower.endswith("_lr") or metric_lower == "lr":
91	            return "last"
92	        if "timing_s/" in metric_lower or "timing_per_token_ms/" in metric_lower:
93	            return "time_sum"
94	        if any(keyword in metric_lower for keyword in ["max", "maximum"]):
95	            return "max"
96	        if any(keyword in metric_lower for keyword in ["min", "minimum"]):
97	            return "min"
98	        if any(keyword in metric_lower for keyword in ["sum", "total"]):
99	            return "sum"
100	        if any(keyword in metric_lower for keyword in ["weighted_avg", "mean", "avg", "average"]):
101	            return "weighted_avg"
102	        return "weighted_avg"
103	
104	    def _aggregate_single_metric(self, metric_name: str, values: list[float]) -> float:
105	        if not values:
106	            return 0.0
107	
108	        agg_type = self._get_aggregation_type(metric_name)
109	        if agg_type == "last":
110	            return values[-1]
111	        if agg_type == "weighted_avg":
112	            weights = self.metric_weights[metric_name]
113	            if len(values) != len(weights) or sum(weights) == 0:
114	                return sum(values) / len(values)
115	            weighted_sum = sum(v * c for v, c in zip(values, weights, strict=False))
116	            return weighted_sum / sum(weights)
117	        if agg_type in ("sum", "time_sum"):
118	            return sum(values)
119	        if agg_type == "max":
120	            return max(values)
121	        if agg_type == "min":
122	            return min(values)
123	        return sum(values) / len(values)
124	
125	    def get_aggregated_metrics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
126	        if self.step_count == 0:
127	            return {}
128	        aggregated = {name: self._aggregate_single_metric(name, values) for name, values in self.metric_values.items()}
129	        for name, counter in self.dict_metrics.items():
130	            if counter:
131	                aggregated[name] = dict(counter)
132	        return self._special_metrics_aggregate(aggregated)
133	
134	    def _special_metrics_aggregate(self, aggregated: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
135	        """Recompute derived metrics that cannot be reduced from their per-iteration values."""
136	        if {"global_seqlen/minmax_diff", "global_seqlen/max", "global_seqlen/min"}.issubset(aggregated):
137	            aggregated["global_seqlen/minmax_diff"] = aggregated["global_seqlen/max"] - aggregated["global_seqlen/min"]
138	
139	        return aggregated
140	
141	    def reset(self):
142	        self.metric_values.clear()
143	        self.metric_weights.clear()
144	        self.dict_metrics.clear()
145	        self.step_count = 0

148	def compute_advantage_for_multi_trajectories(
149	    data: DataProto,
150	    batch_keys: list[str],
151	    adv_estimator,
152	    gamma: float = 1.0,
153	    lam: float = 1.0,
154	    num_repeat: int = 1,
155	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
156	    config: Any = None,
157	) -> DataProto:
158	    """Compute GRPO advantages from each session's final output. For non-GRPO
159	    estimators, such as GAE, are delegated to the original compute_advantage() unchanged.
160	
161	    For GRPO, only the final output in each ``{uid}_{session_id}`` group participates
162	    in advantage computation, and the result is broadcast to the other outputs in
163	    the same session. Sessions whose AgentLoop returns ``None`` simply do not appear
164	    in ``batch_keys``. Non-GRPO estimators, such as GAE, are delegated to the
165	    original ``compute_advantage()`` unchanged.
166	    """
167	    if adv_estimator != core_algos.AdvantageEstimator.GRPO:
168	        return compute_advantage(
169	            data,
170	            adv_estimator=adv_estimator,
171	            gamma=gamma,
172	            lam=lam,
173	            num_repeat=num_repeat,
174	            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
175	            config=config,
176	        )
177	
178	    # final session of each agent loop: {uid}_{session_id} => (index, row_index)
179	    final_sessions: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}
180	    row_session_keys = []
181	    for i, key in enumerate(batch_keys):
182	        fields = key.rsplit("_", 2)
183	        assert len(fields) == 3, f"Unexpected key format: {key}"
184	        uid, session_id, index = fields[0], fields[1], int(fields[2])
185	        session_key = f"{uid}_{session_id}"
186	        row_session_keys.append(session_key)
187	        if session_key not in final_sessions or final_sessions[session_key][0] < index:
188	            final_sessions[session_key] = (index, i)
189	
190	    # final session indices in batch data
191	    final_indices = []
192	    session_key_to_local_index = {}
193	    for session_key, (_, row_index) in final_sessions.items():
194	        final_indices.append(row_index)
195	        session_key_to_local_index[session_key] = len(final_indices) - 1
196	    row_to_local_index = [session_key_to_local_index[session_key] for session_key in row_session_keys]
197	
198	    # select final sessions from batch data for group relative advantage computation
199	    final_data = compute_advantage(
200	        data.select_idxs(final_indices),
201	        adv_estimator=adv_estimator,
202	        gamma=gamma,
203	        lam=lam,
204	        num_repeat=num_repeat,
205	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
206	        config=config,
207	    )
208	    first_nnz_indices = final_data.batch["response_mask"].argmax(dim=1)
209	    final_scores = final_data.batch["advantages"][torch.arange(len(final_data)), first_nnz_indices]
210	
211	    # scatter final scores to all rows in batch data
212	    scores = final_scores[row_to_local_index]
213	    scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * data.batch["response_mask"]
214	
215	    data.batch["advantages"] = scores
216	    data.batch["returns"] = scores
217	    return data

14	"""
15	The vllm_rollout that can be applied in different backend
16	When working with FSDP:
17	- Use DTensor weight loader (recommended) or HF weight loader
18	- Utilize state_dict from the FSDP to synchronize the weights among tp ranks in vLLM
19	When working with Megatron:
20	- Use Megatron weight loader
21	- During training, only the current pp stage holds the parameters
22	- Before inference, broadcast the parameters of the current pp rank
23	  to all other pp ranks (all pp ranks holds all the parameters)
24	- Bind the parameters to the inference engine
25	- Do inference in tp. pp is treated as additional dp
26	- After inference, all the parameters that doesn't belong to this pp rank is freed.
27	"""
28	
29	import logging
30	import os
31	import time
32	from typing import Any, Generator, Optional
33	
34	import ray
35	import torch
36	from torch.distributed.device_mesh import DeviceMesh
37	
38	from verl import DataProto
39	from verl.third_party.vllm import VLLM_SLEEP_LEVEL
40	from verl.utils.device import is_support_ipc
41	from verl.workers.config import HFModelConfig, RolloutConfig
42	from verl.workers.rollout.base import BaseRollout
43	from verl.workers.rollout.vllm_rollout.bucketed_weight_transfer import BucketedWeightSender
44	
45	logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)
46	logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "INFO"))
47	
48	
49	class ServerAdapter(BaseRollout):
50	    """
51	    vLLM server adapter used in native async mode, serve as a client to request vLLM server
52	    to resume/release/update weights and kv_cache.
53	    """
54	
55	    def __init__(
56	        self,
57	        config: RolloutConfig,
58	        model_config: HFModelConfig,
59	        device_mesh: DeviceMesh,
60	        replica_rank: int = -1,
61	    ):
62	        super().__init__(config, model_config, device_mesh)
63	        self.server_handle: ray.actor.ActorHandle = None
64	
65	        rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])
66	        local_world_size = int(os.environ["RAY_LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE"])
67	        # PD asymmetric layout inflates per-replica footprint; must match
68	        # llm_server.py:_initialize_llm_servers or trainer-to-replica mapping breaks.
69	        prefill_tp = self.config.tensor_model_parallel_size
70	        disagg = getattr(self.config, "disaggregation", None)
71	        if disagg is not None and getattr(disagg, "enabled", False):
72	            decode_tp = (
73	                disagg.decode_tensor_model_parallel_size
74	                if disagg.decode_tensor_model_parallel_size is not None
75	                else prefill_tp
76	            )
77	            per_replica = prefill_tp * disagg.prefill_replicas + decode_tp * disagg.decode_replicas
78	        else:
79	            decode_tp = prefill_tp
80	            per_replica = prefill_tp
81	        rollout_world_size = per_replica * self.config.data_parallel_size * self.config.pipeline_model_parallel_size
82	        if replica_rank == -1:
83	            self.replica_rank = rank // rollout_world_size
84	        else:
85	            self.replica_rank = replica_rank
86	        self.rollout_rank = rank % rollout_world_size
87	        self.node_rank = self.rollout_rank // local_world_size
88	
89	        # Map each trainer rank to its co-located vLLM server so weight-update
90	        # IPC handles stay on the GPU where they were created. Offset math
91	        # assumes prefill_replicas == 1 (enforced by vLLMPDReplica); if that
92	        # ever lifts, update both this block and vLLMPDReplica.launch_servers.
93	        self._pd_role: Optional[str] = None
94	        self._pd_server_index: Optional[int] = None
95	        self._pd_tp_local_rank: Optional[int] = None
96	        if disagg is not None and getattr(disagg, "enabled", False):
97	            footprint = prefill_tp + disagg.decode_replicas * decode_tp
98	            local = self.rollout_rank % footprint
99	            if local < prefill_tp:
100	                self._pd_role = "prefill"
101	                self._pd_server_index = 0
102	                self._pd_tp_local_rank = local
103	            else:
104	                off = local - prefill_tp
105	                self._pd_role = "decode"
106	                self._pd_server_index = off // decode_tp
107	                self._pd_tp_local_rank = off % decode_tp
108	            # Each role's TP-rank-0 owns the adapter (vs colocated where every
109	            # rollout_rank=0 owns it). One log line per PD rank at startup so
110	            # a deadlock report can be traced back to the role mapping.
111	            self._has_server = self._pd_tp_local_rank == 0
112	            logger.info(
113	                "vllm PD ServerAdapter: rank=%d replica=%d rollout=%d role=%s server_idx=%s tp_local=%s has_server=%s",
114	                rank,
115	                self.replica_rank,
116	                self.rollout_rank,
117	                self._pd_role,
118	                self._pd_server_index,
119	                self._pd_tp_local_rank,
120	                self._has_server,
121	            )
122	        else:
123	            self._has_server = self.rollout_rank == 0
124	
125	        if config.layered_summon:
126	            logger.warning("Setting the sleep level to 1 may cause a memory overflow.")
127	            self.sleep_level = 1
128	        else:
129	            self.sleep_level = VLLM_SLEEP_LEVEL
130	
131	        # Use replica_rank + node-local rank to form ZMQ handle instead of GPU UUID,
132	        # because CheckpointEngineWorker and vLLM worker may see different GPU UUIDs
133	        # when CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES differs between processes (common on ROCm/AMD).
134	        # Must use node-local rank (not rollout_rank) so it matches vLLM worker's
135	        # local_rank on every node. Include replica_rank to avoid collisions when
136	        # multiple replicas share a node, and the Ray job id so two independent
137	        # verl jobs on the same host (or a new run after a crashed one with a
138	        # stale socket file) cannot collide on the shared /tmp namespace.
139	        local_rank = self.rollout_rank % local_world_size
140	        job_id = ray.get_runtime_context().get_job_id()
141	        self.zmq_handle = f"ipc:///tmp/rl-colocate-zmq-{job_id}-replica-{self.replica_rank}-rank-{local_rank}.sock"
142	
143	        self.use_shm = not is_support_ipc()
144	        if self.use_shm:
145	            logger.warning(
146	                "IPC is not supported on your devices. Falling back to shared memory for weight transfer, "
147	                "which may cause performance degradation. If you are using Ascend NPUs, please ensure that "
148	                "your software and CANN toolkit versions meet the requirements for IPC support. (Ascend HDK version "
149	                ">= 25.3.rc1 and CANN toolkit version >= 8.3.RC1)"
150	            )
151	
152	    def _ensure_server_handle(self) -> bool:
153	        """Lazy-init server handle. Returns False if this rank should not proceed."""
154	        if not self._has_server:
155	            return False
156	        # Lazy init http server adapter because http server is launched after hybrid engine.
157	        if self.server_handle is None:
158	            prefix = self._get_server_name_prefix()
159	            if self._pd_role == "prefill":
160	                actor_name = f"{prefix}server_{self.replica_rank}_0"
161	            elif self._pd_role == "decode":
162	                actor_name = f"{prefix}server_decode_{self.replica_rank}_{self._pd_server_index}"
163	            else:
164	                actor_name = f"{prefix}server_{self.replica_rank}_{self.node_rank}"
165	            self.server_handle = ray.get_actor(actor_name)
166	        return True
167	
168	    async def _execute_method(
169	        self,
170	        method: str,
171	        non_block: bool = False,
172	        timeout: Optional[float] = None,
173	        args: tuple = (),
174	        kwargs: Optional[dict] = None,
175	    ) -> Any:
176	        """Execute method on inference engine via ray.
177	
178	        Args:
179	            method: The method name to execute on the server.
180	            non_block: If True, execute the method asynchronously and return immediately.
181	            timeout: Timeout for the collective_rpc call.
182	            args: Positional arguments for the method.
183	            kwargs: Keyword arguments for the method.
184	
185	        Returns:
186	            The result of the method execution, or None if non_block=True.
187	        """
188	        if not self._ensure_server_handle():
189	            return None
190	
191	        future = self.server_handle.collective_rpc.remote(method, timeout=timeout, args=args, kwargs=kwargs)
192	        return future if non_block else await future
193	
194	    async def resume(self, tags: list[str]):
195	        """Resume rollout weights or kv cache in GPU memory.
196	
197	        Args:
198	            tags: weights or kv_cache.
199	        """
200	        if self.config.free_cache_engine and self._ensure_server_handle():
201	            await self.server_handle.wake_up.remote(tags=tags)
202	
203	    async def release(self):
204	        """Release weights and kv cache in GPU memory."""
205	        if self.config.free_cache_engine and self._ensure_server_handle():
206	            await self.server_handle.sleep.remote()
207	
208	    @torch.no_grad()
209	    async def update_weights(
210	        self,
211	        weights: Generator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor], None, None],
212	        global_steps: int = None,
213	        wire_format: str = "named_tensors",
214	        **kwargs,
215	    ):
216	        """Update model weights via CUDA IPC (fallback to shared memory if IPC not supported) to inference workers."""
217	        assert wire_format == "named_tensors", (
218	            f"vLLM rollout only consumes full named tensors; got wire_format={wire_format!r}"
219	        )
220	        start_time = time.time()
221	
222	        future = await self._execute_method(
223	            "update_weights_from_ipc",
224	            non_block=True,
225	            kwargs={**kwargs, "use_shm": self.use_shm},
226	        )
227	
228	        bucket_size_mb = self.config.checkpoint_engine.update_weights_bucket_megabytes
229	        sender = BucketedWeightSender(
230	            zmq_handle=self.zmq_handle,
231	            bucket_size_mb=bucket_size_mb,
232	            use_shm=self.use_shm,
233	        )
234	        await sender.async_send_weights(weights)
235	
236	        if future is not None:
237	            await future
238	
239	        # reset caches after updating weights
240	        if self._has_server:
241	            await self.server_handle.clear_kv_cache.remote()
242	            if global_steps is not None:
243	                await self.server_handle.set_global_steps.remote(global_steps)
244	
245	        if self.replica_rank == 0 and self.rollout_rank == 0:
246	            logger.info(f"update_weights done, time cost: {time.time() - start_time:.2f}s")
247	
248	    def _get_server_name_prefix(self) -> str:
249	        """Return the Ray actor name prefix matching the rollout type (e.g. 'vllm_')."""
250	        return f"{self.config.get('name', 'vllm')}_"
251	
252	    def generate_sequences(self, prompts: DataProto) -> DataProto:
253	        """Batch generate sequences in sync mode.
254	
255	        Note: ServerAdapter uses async server mode and does not support synchronous
256	        generation. Since SPMD mode was retired (PR #4411), the generation workflow
257	        should use the async server interface instead.
258	
259	        Raises:
260	            NotImplementedError: Always raised as sync generation is not supported.
261	        """
262	        raise NotImplementedError(
263	            "ServerAdapter does not support synchronous generate_sequences(). "
264	            "The vLLM SPMD mode was retired in PR #4411. For batch generation, "
265	            "please use the async server interface via vLLMReplica and LLMServerClient, "
266	            "or use HFRollout for synchronous generation. "
267	            "See https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/4682 for more details."
268	        )
269
